descriptionByLocale.it:
About the Role

The Business Services team in Corporate Solutions Operations is looking for an open-minded Underwriting Assistant with a can-do spirit to be based in Singapore. You will be responsible for primarily supporting the Property and Casualty portfolio.

The role involves high interaction and coordination with underwriters and other internal/external departments, both locally and overseas.

Your main responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Preparation of policy documentation.

• Setting up and finalizing policies in various systems (underwriting, pricing, invoices etc.) ensuring data accuracy.

• To support the Underwriting team with renewal preparation (deal analysis of renewal account) and endorsement triaging and preparation.

• Handling of closings and contract changes.

• Creating and maintaining records both electronically, if required, following established guidelines and processes.

• Handling basic underwriting tasks, renewals, quotes, endorsements including Broker engagement where required.

• To be in contact with your brokers and customers on a regular basis and attend broker and customer meeting where needed.

• Providing support in premium handling, monitoring, and chasing.

• Collaborating with outsourced providers on queries and issues.

• Development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures.

• Modifying, updating, and processing changes in applicable tools, systems, and documents, as needed; and

• Participating in and leading small projects, as required.

About the Team

The team is responsible for administration and operational tasks and support to Underwriters in administration and Underwriting assistance.

About You

• Graduate degree in Business Management or Operations Management

• Passion to deliver excellent service to our customers and internal stakeholders

• Demonstrated analytical skills to determine and communicate recommendations to customers.

• Ability to analyze data following established processes and procedures accurately and efficiently.

• A dedicated team player with ability to demonstrate the highest level of professionalism and integrity.

• Solutions and results oriented individual with an ability to multi-task.

• Strong service and quality mindset.

• Demonstrated intermediate to advanced computer skills and experience with Microsoft Office, Lotus Notes and the Internet. Experience with Visio, Adobe Acrobat Pro, Nitro PDF, MS Project, and Business Objects would be a plus.

• Excellent communication skills – reading, written and verbal

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei un pensatore acuto e curioso che prospera sulla complessità intangling e trasforma intuizioni in azione? Vuoi lavorare in un team dinamico e internazionale che utilizza tecniche all'avanguardia per guidare la resilienza? Se è così, il team di Swiss Re's Group Internal Audit vuole sentire da voi.
Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Audit Manager – Operazioni & Cambiamento all'interno del Gruppo Internal Audit (GIA), sarai al centro del panorama dei rischi e delle assicurazioni di Swiss Re. Portando la tua profonda esperienza tra HR, Legale, Compliance e Comunicazioni, guiderai e formerai audit, inclusi quelli focalizzati sulla Trasformazione e sul Cambiamento, che hanno un impatto reale e di gruppo. Potrai lavorare a spalla con stakeholder senior e teste di funzione in più linee aziendali, aiutando a rafforzare la cultura del rischio e l'ambiente di controllo di Swiss Re. Questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che ama risolvere problemi complessi, comunicare con l'influenza, e fare una differenza tangibile.
Principali responsabilità

• Condurre audit di alta qualità guidando team su standard, metodologie e approcci di test, garantendo rigore e coerenza in tutto

• Valutazioni del rischio di trasmissione — sia cicli di pianificazione annuali che valutazioni in corso — per garantire lo sforzo di audit è proporzionale ai rischi emergenti

• Gestire e nutrire le relazioni degli stakeholder all'interno della vostra area di responsabilità, costruire la fiducia e la credibilità con i leader senior e i responsabili delle funzioni

• Controllare il follow-up dei problemi per garantire che i risultati dell'audit siano affrontati in modo efficace e tempestivo

• Contribuire competenze strategiche al piano di audit GIA, contribuendo a plasmare le priorità che riflettono il panorama dei rischi in evoluzione

• Coach e ispirare i membri del team di audit, promuovere una cultura di curiosità, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo

• Sostenere lo sviluppo del talento aiutando con gli sforzi di reclutamento e fornire feedback significativi delle prestazioni

• Collaborare con esperti interni ed esterni su sfide complesse e ambigue — portando pensiero creativo, orientato al rischio al tavolo
Informazioni sulla squadra
Group Internal Audit (GIA) è un team internazionale di revisori uniti da una visione condivisa: Avanzare la Resilienza di Swiss Re. Siamo risolutori di problemi che sfidano lo status quo, porre le domande difficili, e dimostrare una reale reattività al rischio. Non si limitano le caselle di spunta — si applicano tecniche innovative e orientate al rischio per garantire che i nostri sforzi di audit siano sempre proporzionati e impattanti. Dall'analisi dei dati all'automazione, evolgiamo continuamente i nostri metodi per stare al passo con un ambiente di rischio in continua evoluzione. Unirsi a GIA significa unirsi a un team curioso, collaborativo e impegnato a rendere Swiss Re – e il mondo – più resiliente.
A proposito di te
Sei un esperto professionista di audit con una passione per l'eccellenza operativa, la trasformazione e il rischio. Porti una rara combinazione di profondità tecnica e abilità interpersonali — altrettanto confortevole profonda immersioni in lavori di audit complessi e coinvolgendo con fiducia con gli stakeholder senior. Siete proattivi, organizzati e guidati da un alto senso di responsabilità personale. Si prospera in ambienti in cui l'ambiguità è la norma e l'innovazione è incoraggiata.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• 10+ anni di esperienza nell'audit interno, nell'assicurazione o in una funzione strettamente correlata, con esperienza dimostrabile nelle operazioni, nella conformità e nei controlli sui rischi

• Forte conoscenza della metodologia di audit , tra cui la pianificazione di audit basata sul rischio, la progettazione di test e le pratiche di garanzia della qualità

• Provato record di traccia in trasformazione e cambiamento , sia come revisore o manager supervisionando processi e progetti trasformativi

Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Certificazioni professionali come CPA, CA, CIA, PROSCI, ITIL o equivalente, dimostrando un impegno per gli standard professionali

• Laurea universitaria in un settore rilevante (ad esempio business, diritto, finanza, gestione dei rischi)

• Esperienza di lavoro con l'analisi dei dati o strumenti di automazione di audit , riflettendo un appetito per l'innovazione

• Abilitato nella costruzione e sostenere le relazioni tra diverse squadre interfunzionali e oltre

• Eccellente capacità di scrittura del rapporto, con un focus sulla comunicazione del rischio e impatto aziendale chiaramente e concisamente

• Capacità di influenzare e collaborare efficacemente con gli stakeholder senior attraverso più linee di business

• Una vera passione per l'innovazione, la trasformazione e il miglioramento continuo
Per la Spagna, la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 56 000 € e 94 000 € per un ruolo a tempo pieno.
Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• I requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo

• Il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre, potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici della posizione. L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.
La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Carica il tuo CV in inglese.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Are you a sharp, curious thinker who thrives on untangling complexity and turning insights into action? Do you want to work in a dynamic, international team that uses cutting-edge techniques to drive resilience? If so, Swiss Re's Group Internal Audit team wants to hear from you.

As an Audit Manager – Operations & Change within Group Internal Audit (GIA), you'll be at the heart of Swiss Re's risk and assurance landscape. Bringing your deep expertise across HR, Legal, Compliance, and Communications, you'll lead and shape audits — including those focused on Transformation and Change — that have real, group-wide impact. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior stakeholders and function heads across multiple business lines, helping to strengthen Swiss Re's risk culture and control environment. This is a role for someone who loves solving complex problems, communicating with influence, and making a tangible difference.

Bist du ein scharfer, neugieriger denker, der davon lebt, komplexität zu entwirren und einsichten in die tat umzusetzen?. Möchten Sie in einem dynamischen, internationalen Team arbeiten, das modernste Techniken einsetzt, um Resilienz zu fördern? Wenn ja, möchte das Group Internal Audit-Team von Swiss Re von Ihnen hören.
Über die Rolle
Als Audit Manager – Operations & Change in Group Internal Audit (GIA) stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt der Risiko- und Assurance-Landschaft von Swiss Re. Indem Sie Ihre fundierte Expertise in den Bereichen HR, Legal, Compliance und Kommunikation einbringen, leiten und gestalten Sie Audits - einschließlich solcher, die sich auf Transformation und Wandel konzentrieren -, die echte, gruppenweite Auswirkungen haben. Sie arbeiten Schulter an Schulter mit leitenden Stakeholdern und Funktionsleitern in verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen zusammen und tragen dazu bei, die Risikokultur und das Kontrollumfeld von Swiss Re zu stärken. Dies ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der es liebt, komplexe Probleme zu lösen, mit Einfluss zu kommunizieren und einen greifbaren Unterschied zu machen.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie qualitativ hochwertige Audits durch das Führen von Teams zu Standards, Methoden und Testansätzen durch, um Strenge und Konsistenz zu gewährleisten.

• Förderung von Risikobewertungen — sowohl jährliche Planungszyklen als auch laufende Evaluierungen —, um sicherzustellen, dass der Prüfungsaufwand in einem angemessenen Verhältnis zu neu auftretenden Risiken steht

• Verwalten und pflegen Sie Stakeholder-Beziehungen in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich, bauen Sie Vertrauen und Glaubwürdigkeit mit leitenden Führungskräften und Funktionsleitern auf

• Überwachung der Nachverfolgung von Fragen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Prüfungsergebnisse effektiv und zeitnah behandelt werden

• Tragen Sie strategische Expertise in den GIA-Auditplan ein und tragen Sie dazu bei, Prioritäten zu formulieren, die die sich entwickelnde Risikolandschaft widerspiegeln

• Coach und inspirieren Audit-Teammitglieder, eine Kultur der Neugier, Verantwortlichkeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu fördern

• Unterstützung der Talententwicklung durch Unterstützung bei den Rekrutierungsbemühungen und durch sinnvolles Leistungsfeedback

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Experten bei komplexen, mehrdeutigen Herausforderungen – kreatives, risikoorientiertes Denken an den Tisch bringen
Über das Team
Group Internal Audit (GIA) ist ein vielfältiges, internationales Team von Auditoren, vereint durch eine gemeinsame Vision: Advancing Swiss Re’s Resilience. Wir sind Problemlöser, die den Status quo herausfordern, die schwierigen Fragen stellen und eine echte Reaktionsfähigkeit auf Risiken zeigen. Wir greifen nicht nur Kästchen an – wir wenden innovative, risikoorientierte Techniken an, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Auditbemühungen immer verhältnismäßig und wirkungsvoll sind. Von der Datenanalyse bis hin zur Automatisierung entwickeln wir unsere Methoden kontinuierlich weiter, um einem sich ständig verändernden Risikoumfeld einen Schritt voraus zu sein. Der Beitritt zu GIA bedeutet, sich einem Team anzuschließen, das neugierig, kooperativ und engagiert ist, Swiss Re – und die Welt – widerstandsfähiger zu machen.
Über dich
Sie sind ein erfahrener Audit-Profi mit einer Leidenschaft für operative Exzellenz, Transformation und Risiko. Sie bringen eine seltene Kombination aus technischer Tiefe und zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten mit - ebenso bequem in komplexe Auditarbeiten einzutauchen und sich mit leitenden Stakeholdern vertraut zu machen. Sie sind proaktiv, organisiert und von einem hohen Gefühl der persönlichen Verantwortlichkeit angetrieben. Sie gedeihen in Umgebungen, in denen Mehrdeutigkeit die Norm ist und Innovation gefördert wird.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der internen Revision, Assurance oder einer eng verwandten Funktion mit nachweislicher Expertise in den Bereichen Operations, Compliance und Risikokontrollen

• Starkes Prüfungsmethodikwissen, einschließlich risikobasierter Prüfungsplanung, Testdesign und Qualitätssicherungspraktiken

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in Transformation und Wandel, entweder als Auditor oder als Manager, der transformative Prozesse und Projekte überwacht

Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Professionelle Zertifizierungen wie CPA, CA, CIA, PROSCI, ITIL oder ein gleichwertiges Zertifikat - ein Bekenntnis zu professionellen Standards

• Hochschulabschluss in einem relevanten Bereich (z.B. Wirtschaft, Recht, Finanzen, Risikomanagement)

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Datenanalyse- oder Audit-Automatisierungstools, die einen Innovationshunger widerspiegeln

• Geschickter Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung von Beziehungen in verschiedenen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams und darüber hinaus

• Hervorragende Berichtsschreibfähigkeiten, mit Schwerpunkt auf der klaren und prägnanten Kommunikation von Risiko und Geschäftsauswirkungen

• Fähigkeit zur Einflussnahme und effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Stakeholdern über mehrere Geschäftsbereiche hinweg

• Eine echte Leidenschaft für Innovation, Transformation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
Für Spanien liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 56 000 € und 94 000 € für eine Vollzeitstelle.
Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Verantwortlichkeiten der Rolle

• Eigenes Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung
Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt. Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen. Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Bitte laden Sie Ihren Lebenslauf auf Englisch hoch.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

Sei un professionista finanziario motivato che cerca di crescere la tua esperienza di contabilità in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale?

Responsabilità chiave:

• Contribuisci ai miglioramenti del sistema e alle attività di test, tra cui Test di accettazione utente, sotto la guida

Il team gestisce i processi finanziari globali di riassicurazione interna in tutti gli enti di Swiss Re, tra cui la configurazione dei contratti, il calcolo, il reporting e la risoluzione delle transazioni.
Siamo un team internazionale e collaborativo che valorizza comunicazione aperta, affidabilità e apprendimento continuo. Sosteniamo la condivisione delle conoscenze e forniamo un ambiente positivo per lo sviluppo di nuove competenze e per lo sviluppo professionale e personale.

• Laurea in finanza o contabilità
• 1-3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo finanziario o contabile
• Esperienza di base con sistemi di contabilità o reporting (ad esempio SAP, Oracle)
• Buona conoscenza di MS Excel
• Inglese fluente (scritto e parlato)
• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e alla volontà di imparare
• Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione e seguire processi consolidati
Bello da avere:
• Esposizione a US GAAP e/o IFRS
• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente funzionale internazionale o trasversale

Are you a motivated finance professional looking to grow your accounting expertise in a dynamic, international environment?
Join our Intra-Group Retrocession (IGR) team and develop your skills while supporting key internal reinsurance processes and collaborating with teams across Swiss Re. In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with financial processes, systems, and accounting topics, working closely with experienced colleagues in a supportive environment.
About the Role
You will support the execution of core financial processes that connect different parts of Swiss Re’s business. Working in a structured and supportive environment, you will contribute to the lifecycle of Intra-Group Reinsurance (IGR) transactions and help ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
Key Responsibilities:
•  Support quarterly financial production for Intra-Group Reinsurance transactions, following defined timelines and guidelines
•  Assist with the set up and maintenance of IGR contracts in finance systems, ensuring data accuracy and completeness
•  Prepare financial results and perform reconciliations and basic validations to support reporting processes
•  Execute standard accounting and reporting activities in line with established processes and internal controls
•  Contribute to system enhancements and testing activities, including User Acceptance Testing, under guidance
•  Collaborate with Finance teams and cross-functional functions (e.g. Risk Management, Treasury, and Audit), to support operational processes
About the Team
The Intra Group Reinsurance team, established in 2018, is part of Global Finance Operations & Transformation team (GFO&T). The team manages global internal reinsurance financial processes across Swiss Re entities, including contract setup, calculation, reporting, and settlement of transactions.
We are an international and collaborative team that values open communication, reliability, and continuous learning. We support knowledge sharing and provide a positive environment for developing new skills and gaining professional and personal development.
About You
You are a detail oriented finance professional who enjoys working with numbers and structured processes. You are eager to learn, comfortable working in an international environment, and able to manage multiple tasks with guidance and support.
We are looking for candidates with:
•  Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting
•  1–3 years of experience in a finance or accounting role
•  Basic experience with accounting or reporting systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle)
•  Good knowledge of MS Excel
•  Fluent English (written and spoken)
•  Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn
•  Ability to work collaboratively and follow established processes
Nice to have:
•  Exposure to US GAAP and/or IFRS
•  Experience working in an international or cross functional environment
•  Interest in developing deeper expertise in accounting or reinsurance topics

For Slovakia, the base salary range for this position is between 1,300 EUR and 2,200 EUR for a full-time role.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. Our aim is to live visible and invisible diversity – diversity of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, physical abilities, personalities and experiences – at all levels and in all functions and regions. We also collaborate in a flexible working environment, providing you with a compelling degree of autonomy to decide how, when and where to carry out your tasks.
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

Sind Sie ein motivierter Finanzprofi, der Ihre Buchhaltungskompetenz in einem dynamischen, internationalen Umfeld ausbauen möchte?
Treten Sie unserem Team für gruppeninterne Retrozessionen (IGR) bei und entwickeln Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten, während Sie wichtige interne Rückversicherungsprozesse unterstützen und mit Teams von Swiss Re zusammenarbeiten. In dieser Rolle sammeln Sie praktische Erfahrungen mit Finanzprozessen, Systemen und Buchhaltungsthemen und arbeiten eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen in einem unterstützenden Umfeld zusammen.
Über die Rolle
Sie unterstützen die Durchführung von Kernfinanzprozessen, die verschiedene Teile des Geschäfts von Swiss Re verbinden. In einem strukturierten und unterstützenden Umfeld tragen Sie zum Lebenszyklus von gruppeninternen Rückversicherungstransaktionen (IGR) bei und sorgen für eine genaue, zeitnahe und konforme Finanzberichterstattung.
Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Unterstützung der vierteljährlichen Finanzproduktion für gruppeninterne Rückversicherungstransaktionen nach definierten Zeitplänen und Richtlinien
• Unterstützung bei der Einrichtung und Pflege von IGR-Verträgen in Finanzsystemen, um die Genauigkeit und Vollständigkeit der Daten zu gewährleisten
• Bereiten Sie Finanzergebnisse vor und führen Sie Abgleiche und grundlegende Validierungen durch, um die Berichtsprozesse zu unterstützen
• Durchführung von Standardbuchhaltungs- und Berichtsaktivitäten im Einklang mit etablierten Prozessen und internen Kontrollen
• Beitrag zu Systemverbesserungen und Testaktivitäten, einschließlich User Acceptance Testing, unter Anleitung
• Zusammenarbeit mit Finanzteams und funktionsübergreifenden Funktionen (z. B. Risikomanagement, Treasury und Audit), um operative Prozesse zu unterstützen
Über das Team
Das 2018 gegründete Intra Group Reinsurance Team ist Teil des Global Finance Operations & Transformation Teams (GFO&T). Das Team verwaltet die globalen internen Rückversicherungs-Finanzprozesse in den Einheiten von Swiss Re, einschließlich Vertragsaufbau, Berechnung, Berichterstattung und Abwicklung von Transaktionen.
Wir sind ein internationales und kooperatives Team, das offene Kommunikation, Zuverlässigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen schätzt. Wir unterstützen den Wissensaustausch und bieten ein positives Umfeld für die Entwicklung neuer Fähigkeiten und die berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
Über dich
Sie sind ein detailorientierter Finanzprofi, der gerne mit Zahlen und strukturierten Prozessen arbeitet. Sie sind lernbegierig, fühlen sich wohl in einem internationalen Umfeld und können mehrere Aufgaben mit Anleitung und Unterstützung bewältigen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten mit:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen oder Rechnungswesen
• 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Finanz- oder Buchhaltungsrolle
• Grundkenntnisse mit Buchhaltungs- oder Berichtssystemen (z.B. SAP, Oracle)
• Gute Kenntnisse von MS Excel
• fließendes Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen)
• Starke Liebe zum Detail und Lernbereitschaft
• Fähigkeit, gemeinsam zu arbeiten und etablierte Prozesse zu verfolgen
Schön zu haben:
• Exposition gegenüber US-GAAP und/oder IFRS
• Erfahrung in einem internationalen oder funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld
• Interesse an der Entwicklung tieferer Expertise in Rechnungslegungs- oder Rückversicherungsthemen

Êtes-vous un professionnel de la finance motivé qui cherche à développer votre expertise comptable dans un environnement dynamique et international?
Rejoignez notre équipe de rétrocession intragroupe (IGR) et développez vos compétences tout en soutenant les processus clés de réassurance interne et en collaborant avec des équipes à travers Swiss Re. Dans ce rôle, vous acquerrez une expérience pratique des processus financiers, des systèmes et des sujets comptables, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des collègues expérimentés dans un environnement favorable.
À propos du rôle
Vous soutiendrez l'exécution de processus financiers de base qui relient différentes parties de l'activité de la Swiss Re. En travaillant dans un environnement structuré et favorable, vous contribuerez au cycle de vie des opérations de réassurance intragroupe (RGI) et vous aiderez à obtenir des rapports financiers exacts, opportuns et conformes.
Principales responsabilités :
• Soutenir la production financière trimestrielle pour les opérations de réassurance intragroupe, selon des délais et des lignes directrices définis
• Aider à la mise en place et à la maintenance des contrats IGR dans les systèmes financiers, en assurant l'exactitude et l'exhaustivité des données
• Préparer les résultats financiers et effectuer des rapprochements et des validations de base pour appuyer les processus de rapport
• Exécuter des activités normalisées de comptabilité et d ' établissement de rapports conformément aux procédures établies et aux contrôles internes
• Contribuer aux améliorations du système et aux activités d'essai, y compris les essais d'acceptation par les utilisateurs, sous la direction
• Collaborer avec les équipes des finances et les fonctions interfonctionnelles (p. ex. gestion des risques, trésorerie et vérification) pour appuyer les processus opérationnels
À propos de l'équipe
L'équipe de réassurance d'Intra Group, créée en 2018, fait partie de l'équipe des opérations et de la transformation des finances mondiales (GFO&T). L'équipe gère les processus financiers de réassurance interne globale dans toutes les entités Swiss Re, y compris la configuration des contrats, le calcul, la déclaration et le règlement des transactions.
Nous sommes une équipe internationale et collaborative qui valorise la communication ouverte, la fiabilité et l'apprentissage continu. Nous soutenons le partage des connaissances et fournissons un environnement positif pour le développement de nouvelles compétences et l'acquisition de développement professionnel et personnel.
À propos de toi
Vous êtes un professionnel de la finance axé sur les détails qui aime travailler avec les nombres et les processus structurés. Vous êtes impatient d'apprendre, à l'aise de travailler dans un environnement international, et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches avec des conseils et un soutien.
Nous cherchons des candidats avec :
• Baccalauréat en finance ou en comptabilité
• 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en finance ou en comptabilité
• Expérience de base en matière de systèmes de comptabilité ou de rapports (par exemple SAP, Oracle)
• Bonne connaissance de MS Excel
• Anglais (écrit et parlé)
• Pleine attention aux détails et à la volonté d'apprendre
• Capacité de travailler en collaboration et de suivre les processus établis
Sympa d'avoir:
• Expositions aux PCGR américains et/ou aux IFRS
• Expérience de travail dans un environnement international ou transfonctionnel
• Intérêt à développer une expertise approfondie en matière de comptabilité ou de réassurance

Pour la Slovaquie, l'échelle salariale de base pour ce poste se situe entre 1 300 EUR et 2 200 EUR pour un poste à temps plein.
Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:
• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle
• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience
Si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences ou si vous les dépassez considérablement, le salaire offert peut être inférieur ou supérieur à la fourchette annoncée. En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à des récompenses et des avantages supplémentaires, y compris une prime annuelle axée sur le rendement attrayante.

Nous collaborons également dans un environnement de travail flexible, vous offrant un degré d'autonomie convaincant pour décider comment, quand et où exécuter vos tâches.
Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.

Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.

Nous aidons les clients à atténuer leur exposition aux risques, tandis que notre service de réclamation leader de l'industrie leur procure une plus grande tranquillité d'esprit.

Join a team of security and technology professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient.

We're looking for an experienced, forward-thinking Cyber Security Analyst who will manage the production of detection content and incident investigation and help us to improve our incident response techniques. As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will be monitoring current threats by analysing and handling major cyber incidents, implementing standards and mentoring less experienced analysts.

What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup (50:50), balancing work from home and the office premises (office presence required 2–3 days per week).

About The Role

Group Security & Technology Platforms (GSTP) brings together security, technology platforms and operational resilience to provide secure, reliable and scalable foundations for Swiss Re's business. The function ensures that security, resilience and engineering quality are embedded by design into how technology is built, operated and evolved across the organisation.

You will be part of the Cyber Defence team – made of passionate individuals who keep the company safe by going above and beyond in terms of preciseness and diligence. We oversee the maintenance of security operations, focusing on delivering high-quality detection monitoring and response solutions. Our team values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning, providing you with a stimulating environment to grow your expertise and make a tangible impact on our cybersecurity practises.

In your role, you will perform:

• Security monitoring – Oversee security operations, use advanced tools to monitor and analyse alerts, proactively detect incidents in real time, investigate and coordinate responses

• Incident response – Investigate security incidents, contain breaches and implement remediation strategies

• Operational excellence – Implement and maintain high operational standards

• Threat intelligence – Stay updated on cybersecurity threats and trends

• On-call duty – Participate in on-call rotations to address urgent matters outside of regular working hours

What we need from you:

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of threat analysis and detection, we'll be more than happy to meet you!

• Experience in cybersecurity as a Security Analyst or Incident Responder (preferably in SOC/CSIRT setup)

• In-depth knowledge of current threat landscape, offensive tooling and OWASP and industry-standard security framework, such as MITRE ATT&CK® techniques and Cyber Kill Chain

• Experience in malware and exploit analysis (or reverse engineering)

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

• Effective communication and presentation abilities to articulate and present complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have:

• Experience developing in Python, Kusto or any other scripting language

• Experience with Azure or Amazon AWS

• Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP solutions

For Switzerland the base salary range for this position is between CHF 108,000 and CHF 162,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

The function ensures that security, resilience and engineering quality are embedded by design into how technology is built, operated and evolved across the organisation.

You will be part of the Cyber Defence team – made of passionate individuals who keep the company safe by going above and beyond in terms of preciseness and diligence. We oversee the maintenance of security operations, focusing on delivering high-quality detection monitoring and response solutions. Our team values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning, providing you with a stimulating environment to grow your expertise and make a tangible impact on our cybersecurity practises.

In your role, you will perform:

• Security monitoring – Oversee security operations, use advanced tools to monitor and analyse alerts, proactively detect incidents in real time, investigate and coordinate responses

• Incident response – Investigate security incidents, contain breaches and implement remediation strategies

• Operational excellence – Implement and maintain high operational standards

• Threat intelligence – Stay updated on cybersecurity threats and trends

• On-call duty – Participate in on-call rotations to address urgent matters outside of regular working hours

What we need from you:

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of threat analysis and detection, we'll be more than happy to meet you!

• Experience in cybersecurity as a Security Analyst or Incident Responder (preferably in SOC/CSIRT setup)

• In-depth knowledge of current threat landscape, offensive tooling and OWASP and industry-standard security framework, such as MITRE ATT&CK® techniques and Cyber Kill Chain

• Experience in malware and exploit analysis (or reverse engineering)

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

• Effective communication and presentation abilities to articulate and present complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have:

• Experience developing in Python, Kusto or any other scripting language

• Experience with Azure or Amazon AWS

• Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP solutions

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Informazioni sulla squadra

Il team di Abilitazione avanzata Analytics fa parte delle operazioni aziendali e dell'implementazione all'interno delle operazioni di P&C Re. Il team è responsabile dello sviluppo e del mantenimento del paesaggio di analisi delle operazioni di P&C Re, supportando funzioni come le operazioni di scrittura, le operazioni di contabilità e reclami tecnici, la gestione dei reclami, la gestione delle forze in-force e l'audit client.

Generiamo intuizioni aziendali attuabili applicando soluzioni avanzate di analisi, automazione e AI-driven e fungendo da ponte tra business e IT.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Alla ricerca di uno scienziato di dati Junior per lavorare sulla risoluzione di problemi di business ad alta priorità utilizzando approcci basati sui dati e analisi avanzate. Questo ruolo è basato a Bangalore e lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Leader di analisi avanzata, membri del team, IT/D&T e stakeholder aziendali.

Contribuirai a iniziative di analisi in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto, supporterai l'evoluzione della nostra piattaforma di analisi e AI, e lavorerai con i membri del team senior per sviluppare soluzioni dai PoC esplorativi alle capacità progettuali con un impatto commerciale misurabile.

Principali responsabilità

• Tradurre le esigenze aziendali in dichiarazioni di problemi analitici ben definite e sviluppare soluzioni basate sui dati con la guida da parte dei membri del team senior.

• Applicare tecniche statistiche, algoritmiche, data mining e visualizzazione per generare insight aziendali.

• Contribuisci a soluzioni di data science end-to-end, dallo sviluppo di PoC alla distribuzione di produzione, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team aziendali e IT.

• Identificare le lacune dei dati e proporre miglioramenti ai processi di raccolta dati.

• Assumere la proprietà dei compiti assegnati e dei responsabili, collaborare efficacemente con gli stakeholder e contribuire a soluzioni innovative.

A proposito di te

Competenze tecniche

• Laurea magistrale in campo quantitativo (STEM, Economia, Statistica, Ingegneria o simile).

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza pratica nella costruzione di soluzioni di scienza dei dati.

• Buona fondazione nelle statistiche e probabilità.

• Esperienza pratica con tecniche di machine learning classiche, come algoritmi parametrici (regressione lineare/logistica), metodi di ensemble (alberi di decisione, foreste casuali, XGBost / LightGBM ), clustering (k-means, clustering gerarchico), e riduzione della dimensionalità (PCA), con esposizione a caratteristiche ingegneristiche, tuning iperparametro e valutazione del modello.

• Esposizione a NLP e applicati casi di uso di AI Generativo (ad esempio, LLM, ingegneria rapida, RAG).

• Competenza in Python; conoscenza operativa di Spark ( PySpark) e librerie ML/AI comuni.

• Preferito: SQL, Power BI; esposizione di dominio di assicurazione/riassicurazione.

Abilità morbide

• comunicatore chiaro e conciso (scritto e verbale), in grado di personalizzare la comunicazione a pubblico tecnico e non tecnico.

• Forte problem-solver con una mentalità di consulenza e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con ambiguità.

• Confortevole funzionamento in un'organizzazione di matrice e influenzare le parti interessate senza autorità formale.

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra i 1.600 euro e i 600 euro al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione.
L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

About the Team

The Enabling Advanced Analytics team is part of  Business Operations and Enablement within P&C Re Operations. The team  is responsible for  developing and  maintaining  the P&C Re Operations analytics landscape, supporting functions such as Underwriting Operations, Technical Accounting & Claims Operations, Claims Management, In-force Management, and Client Audit.

We generate actionable business insights by applying advanced analytics, automation, and AI-driven solutions, and act as a bridge between business and IT.

About the Role

Looking for a Junior Data Scientist to work on solving high-priority business problems using data-driven approaches and advanced analytics. This role is based in  Bangalore  and will work closely with the Advanced Analytics Lead, team members, IT/D&T, and business stakeholders.

You will contribute to analytics initiatives across the project lifecycle, support the evolution of our analytics and AI platform, and work with senior team members to develop solutions from exploratory  PoCs  to production-ready capabilities with measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Translate business needs into well-defined analytical problem statements and develop data-driven solutions with guidance from senior team members.

• Apply statistical, algorithmic, data mining, and visualization techniques to generate business insights.

• Contribute to end- to- end data science solutions, from PoC development to production deployment, working closely with business and IT teams.

• Identify  data gaps and propose improvements to the data collection processes.

• Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, collaborate effectively with stakeholders, and contribute to innovative solutions.

About You

Technical Skills

• Master’s degree in quantitative field (STEM, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or similar).

• Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in building data science solutions.

• Good foundation in statistics and probability.

• Practical experience with classical machine learning techniques, such as parametric algorithms (linear/logistic regression), ensemble methods (decision trees, random forests,  XGBoost / LightGBM ), clustering (k-means, hierarchical clustering), and  dimensionality reduction (PCA), with exposure to feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and model evaluation.

• Exposure to NLP and applied Generative AI use cases (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG).

• Proficiency  in Python; working knowledge of Spark ( PySpark ) and common ML/AI libraries.

• Preferred: SQL, Power BI; insurance/reinsurance domain exposure.

Soft Skills

• Clear and concise communicator (written and verbal), able to tailor communication to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong problem-solver with a consulting mindset and the ability to work effectively with ambiguity.

• Comfortable operating in a matrix organization and influencing stakeholders without formal authority.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

Das Enabling Advanced Analytics-Team ist Teil von Business Operations und Enablement innerhalb von P&C Re Operations. Das Team ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Pflege der P&C Re Operations Analytics-Landschaft und unterstützt Funktionen wie Underwriting Operations, Technical Accounting & Claims Operations, Claims Management, Inforce Management und Client Audit.

Wir generieren umsetzbare Business Insights durch die Anwendung von Advanced Analytics, Automatisierung und KI-gesteuerten Lösungen und fungieren als Brücke zwischen Business und IT.

Über die Rolle

Auf der Suche nach einem Junior Data Scientist, der an der Lösung von Geschäftsproblemen mit hoher Priorität mit datengesteuerten Ansätzen und fortschrittlichen Analysen arbeitet. Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Bangalore und wird eng mit dem Advanced Analytics Lead, den Teammitgliedern, IT / D & T und den Stakeholdern der Unternehmen zusammenarbeiten.

Sie werden während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus zu Analyseinitiativen beitragen, die Entwicklung unserer Analyse- und KI-Plattform unterstützen und mit leitenden Teammitgliedern zusammenarbeiten, um Lösungen von explorativen PoCs bis hin zu produktionsfähigen Funktionen mit messbaren Geschäftsauswirkungen zu entwickeln.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in klar definierte analytische Problemstellungen und entwickeln Sie datengesteuerte Lösungen unter Anleitung von leitenden Teammitgliedern.

• Wenden Sie statistische, algorithmische, Data Mining- und Visualisierungstechniken an, um Business Insights zu generieren.

• Tragen Sie zu End-to-End-Data-Science-Lösungen bei, von der PoC-Entwicklung bis zum Produktionseinsatz und arbeiten Sie eng mit Geschäfts- und IT-Teams zusammen.

• Identifizieren Sie Datenlücken und schlagen Sie Verbesserungen der Datenerhebungsprozesse vor.

• Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für zugewiesene Aufgaben und Ergebnisse, arbeiten Sie effektiv mit Stakeholdern zusammen und tragen Sie zu innovativen Lösungen bei.

Über dich

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Master-Abschluss im quantitativen Bereich (STEM, Wirtschaft, Statistik, Ingenieurwesen oder ähnliches).

• Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau von Data Science-Lösungen.

• Gute Grundlage in Statistik und Wahrscheinlichkeit.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit klassischen maschinellen Lerntechniken, wie parametrische Algorithmen (lineare / logistische Regression), Ensemble-Methoden (Entscheidungsbäume, Zufallswälder, XGBoost / LightGBM), Clustering (k-means, hierarchisches Clustering) und Dimensionalitätsreduktion (PCA), mit Exposition gegenüber Feature Engineering, Hyperparameter-Tuning und Modellbewertung.

• Exposition gegenüber NLP und angewandten Generative AI Use Cases (z.B. LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG).

• Kenntnisse in Python; Kenntnisse über Spark (PySpark) und gemeinsame ML / AI-Bibliotheken.

• Bevorzugt: SQL, Power BI; Versicherungs- / Rückversicherungsdomain-Exposure.

Soft Skills

• Klarer und prägnanter Kommunikator (schriftlich und mündlich), der in der Lage ist, die Kommunikation auf technische und nicht-technische Zielgruppen zuzuschneiden.

• Starker Problemlöser mit einer beratenden Denkweise und der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Mehrdeutigkeit zu arbeiten.

• Komfortables Arbeiten in einer Matrixorganisation und Beeinflussung von Stakeholdern ohne formale Autorität.

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Für die Slowakei liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen [1.600 EUR] und [2.600 EUR] pro Monat (für eine Vollzeitstelle). Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,

• das Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt. Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen.
Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.

Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

À propos de l'équipe

L'équipe d'analyse avancée habilitante fait partie des opérations opérationnelles et d'activation au sein des opérations de P&C Re. L'équipe est chargée d'élaborer et de maintenir le paysage analytique des opérations de R & C, ainsi que des fonctions d'appui comme les opérations de souscription, les opérations de comptabilité technique et de réclamation, la gestion des réclamations, la gestion en vigueur et la vérification des clients.

Nous produisons des informations d'affaires exploitables en appliquant des solutions avancées d'analyse, d'automatisation et d'IA, et agissons comme un pont entre entreprise et IT.

À propos du rôle

Recherche d'un chercheur en données junior pour travailler à résoudre des problèmes opérationnels hautement prioritaires en utilisant des approches axées sur les données et des analyses avancées. Ce rôle est basé à Bangalore et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'analyse avancée, les membres de l'équipe, les TI/D&T et les intervenants commerciaux.

Vous contribuerez aux initiatives d'analyse tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, supporterez l'évolution de notre plateforme d'analyse et d'IA, et travaillerez avec des membres de l'équipe senior pour développer des solutions allant des PdC exploratoires aux capacités prêtes à la production avec un impact opérationnel mesurable.

Principales responsabilités

• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en énoncés de problèmes analytiques bien définis et développer des solutions axées sur les données avec l'orientation des membres de l'équipe senior.

• Appliquer des techniques statistiques, algorithmiques, d'extraction de données et de visualisation pour générer des perspectives d'affaires.

• Contribuer à des solutions bout à bout en matière de science des données, de l'élaboration du PdC au déploiement de la production, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'affaires et de TI.

• Identifier les lacunes dans les données et proposer des améliorations aux processus de collecte des données.

• Prendre en main les tâches et les produits livrables assignés, collaborer efficacement avec les intervenants et contribuer à des solutions novatrices.

À propos de toi

Compétences techniques

• Maîtrise en domaine quantitatif (STEM, économie, statistique, ingénierie ou similaire).

• Minimum 2 ans d'expérience pratique dans l'élaboration de solutions de science des données.

• Bonne base en statistiques et probabilités.

• Expérience pratique des techniques classiques d'apprentissage automatique, telles que les algorithmes paramétriques (régression linéaire/logistique), les méthodes d'ensemble (arbres décisionnels, forêts aléatoires, XGBoost / LightGBM), les regroupements (moyennes k, regroupements hiérarchiques) et la réduction de dimensionnalité (PCA), avec l'exposition à l'ingénierie des fonctionnalités, le réglage hyperparamétrique et l'évaluation des modèles.

• Exposition au NLP et aux cas d'utilisation d'IA Generative (p. ex. LLM, génie rapide, RAG).

• Compétence en Python; connaissance pratique des bibliothèques Spark (PySpark) et ML/AI communes.

• Préféré : SQL, Power BI; assurance/réassurance.

Compétences douces

• Communication claire et concise (écrite et verbale), capable d'adapter la communication aux publics techniques et non techniques.

• Forte résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit de consultation et la capacité de travailler efficacement avec ambiguïté.

• Un fonctionnement confortable dans une organisation matricielle et une influence sur les intervenants sans autorité officielle.

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
Pour la Slovaquie, l'échelle de salaire de base pour ce poste se situe entre [1,600 EUR] et [2,600 EUR] par mois (pour un poste à temps plein). Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle,

• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience.

En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement.
L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.

À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

Functional Title: ESM ServiceNow DevSecOps Engineer II
Location: Bangalore
Are you looking for an opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing environment? Do you like to work for the collective success of the team? We are looking for an enthusiastic, skilled ServiceNow Developer to join our dynamic team at Swiss Re.
Is this for you? Then we want to get to know you!
About the team
We are leaders in the design, development and management of state-of-the-art service management, operations and automation solutions for our clients inside and outside Swiss Re.
Our offering includes best-in-class platform and solution architecture services complemented by robust guiding principles.
We apply a dynamic governance process that strikes a perfect balance between short-term gains and long-term value creation while maintaining a consistent, standardized and compliant Enterprise Service Management / ServiceNow platform.
We ensure that your team is equipped with the right skills, capabilities and resources to succeed.
Our platform development focuses on realizing the full potential of your ServiceNow platform by reducing costs, introducing breakthrough features and enhancing existing capabilities.
Over the last ten years, we have developed over 60 applications, 20 Service Management Processes und 160 Business Services with ServiceNow which span across all areas of our company. We operate in a scaled agile model with shared leadership and aligned autonomy among our squads. Our globally dispersed team embodies values of passion, openness, respect, humility, and curiosity, continuously striving to improve our work for our customers.
About the role
In this role, you will closely collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and solution architects to develop advanced solutions. Your ability to understand the broader organizational context will be essential as you contribute to building complex workflows and business processes.
Key Responsibilities
Development and Implementation

• Build comprehensive knowledge and maintain a strong understanding of the various applications within the squad to ensure effective development

• Involved in development of complex workflows, business processes, and applications, delivering entire epics independently while adhering to established guardrails and best practices.

• Good troubleshooting skills ensuring operational issues are addressed in a timely manner.

• Build integrations with external systems using SOAP/REST protocols and handle data transformation as required.

• Effectively manage operational aspects of development to ensure smooth execution.
Quality Assurance

• Mentor junior developers, providing support through work reviews and peer testing to ensure the quality of deliverables is maintained.

• Conduct peer reviews to promote best practices and enhance overall team performance.
Self-Organization

• Demonstrate strong self-organization skills a sense of ownership in work and deliverables

• Willing to learn, up-skill and have a drive for professional development

• Show true teamwork, have a flexible and team-based approach to working with the ability to work independently and take personal accountability
Essentials

• 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience

• Good understanding of OOPs concepts

• High proficiency in JavaScript and good experience in building custom applications on ServiceNow

• Experience in designing, configuring, and customizing Service Portal to deliver intuitive, user-friendly self-service experiences.

• Deep expertise in the ServiceNow platform, including security implementation and building scripted REST APIs, HTML/CSS, AJAX, JSON, AngularJS

• Ability to generate data models and translate low-level designs into implementation code.

• Experience in creating automated tests at the use-case level to build a robust regression suite

• Good analytical and troubleshooting skills

• DevSecOps mind-set of “You build it – You run it”
Nice to have:

• Proficiency on Identity and Access management process

• Understanding of CICD process

• Prior experience on any object-oriented programming languages
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di analisi finanziaria e pronto a svolgere un ruolo cruciale in un leader di riassicurazione globale? Unisciti al nostro team di contabilità tecnica di Bangalore dove potrai sfruttare le tue competenze analitiche per garantire l'accuratezza finanziaria mentre collabora con gli stakeholder in tutto il mondo!

Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di Senior TA Analyst, sarai al centro delle nostre operazioni finanziarie, garantendo l'accuratezza delle transazioni premium e reclamate, fornendo preziose informazioni attraverso l'analisi dei dati. Potrai lavorare con parti interessate interne ed esterne per risolvere problemi di contabilità complessi e contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi.

Principali responsabilità
Contratto Compliance- Convalida e analizza i dati premium e rivendica i dati contro i contratti / accordi per garantire la conformità
Convalida finanziaria- Monitorare i numeri finanziari nei sistemi di contabilità tecnica e identificare le tendenze negativepremium/claim dai dati del cliente
Analisi dei dati- Sviluppare i riassunti dell'analisi dei dati che aiutano il processo decisionale attraverso più sistemi interfunzionali
Performance Management- Fornisci impegni operativi e indicatori chiave di performance per gestire efficacemente il flusso di cassa
Stakeholder Management- Costruire relazioni forti con gli stakeholder e contribuire a rafforzare le relazioni dei clienti, lavorare efficacemente con più squadre matrici tra i Boundaries Geografici per implementare le migliori pratiche.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Questa posizione fa parte dell'organizzazione Global Technical Accounting & Services per Life & Health Business, che ha la responsabilità generale per le funzioni di contabilità tecnica in tutto il mondo, tra cui Business Solution Centers. Il team assicura che i pagamenti ricevuti dai clienti (premiums) e i pagamenti effettuati ai clienti (ricerca) si riconciliano con gli importi attesi. La ricerca di soluzioni innovative è fondamentale per il successo del team. Il ruolo riporta al Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.

A proposito di te

Sei un professionista finanziario orientato al dettaglio con forti capacità analitiche e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione. Giovani in un ambiente collaborativo e si impegnano a fornire risultati di alta qualità. La tua capacità di gestire le relazioni con gli stakeholder e analizzare i dati finanziari complessi ti rende un candidato ideale per questo ruolo.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Laureato in Commercio, Contabilità, Assicurazione o campo equivalente

• 3+ anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore bancario, assicurativo o di altri servizi finanziari

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale con eccellenti capacità di gestione dei clienti

• Prove competenze analitiche e esperienza di lavoro con i dati finanziari

• Conoscenza del prodotto assicurativo sano e comprensione dell'assicurazione/assicurazione catena di valore end-to-end

Questi sono ulteriori bello avere:

• Esperienza con SAS e Python

• Esperienza precedente in contabilità tecnica o ruoli simili in riassicurazione

• Conoscenza degli standard internazionali di reporting finanziario

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente globale e multiculturale

• Capacità di problem solving e la capacità di lavorare sotto pressione

• La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Are you passionate about financial analysis and ready to play a crucial role in a global reinsurance leader? Join ourTechnical Accounting team in Bangalore where you'll leverage your analytical expertise to ensure financialaccuracy while collaborating with stakeholders worldwide!

About the Role

As a Senior TA Analyst, you'll be at the heart of our financial operations, ensuring the accuracy of premium andclaim transactions while providing valuable insights through data analysis. You'll work with both internal andexternal stakeholders to resolve complex accounting issues and contribute to the continuous improvement of ourprocesses.

Key Responsibilities
Contract Compliance- Validate and analyze premium and claims data against contract wordings/agreementsto ensure compliance
Financial Validation- Monitor financial numbers in Technical Accounting systems and identify adversepremium/claim trends from client data
Data Analysis- Develop data analysis summaries that aid decision-making across multiple cross-functionalteams
Performance Management- Deliver consistently operational commitments and key performance indicators toeffectively manage cash flow
Stakeholder Management- Build strong relationships with stakeholders and contribute to strengthening clientrelationships, work effectively with multiple matrixed teams across Geographical Boundaries to implementbest practices.
About the Team
This position is part of the Global Technical Accounting & Services organization for Life & Health Business, whichhas overall responsibility for Technical Accounting functions worldwide, including Business Solution Centers. Theteam ensures that payments received from clients (premiums) and payments made to clients (claims) reconcileagainst expected amounts. Working within established frameworks while finding innovative solutions is key to theteam's success. The role reports to the Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.

About You

You're a detail-oriented financial professional with strong analytical skills and excellent communication skills. Youthrive in a collaborative environment and are committed to delivering high-quality results. Your ability to managerelationships with stakeholders and analyze complex financial data makes you an ideal candidate for this role.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Accounting, Insurance or equivalent field

• 3+ years of work experience in banking, insurance, or other financial services industries

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent client management abilities

• Proven data analytical skills and experience working with financial data

• Sound insurance product knowledge and understanding of Insurance/Reinsurance End-to-End Value Chain

These are additional nice to have:

•  Experience with SAS and Python

•  Previous experience in technical accounting or similar roles in reinsurance

•  Knowledge of international financial reporting standards

• Experience working in a global, multicultural environment

• Problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure

• Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
