descriptionByLocale.it:
Questo ruolo si trova all'interno della UK Market Unit del team L&H Valuation EMEA. Sarete responsabili di garantire la reportistica accurata e tempestiva del portafoglio di UK Life attraverso più basi di valutazione. Il ruolo consiste nell'impostare i presupposti di valutazione e nel lavorare a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali (XFT) per fornire risultati di valutazione robusti e conformi.
Stiamo cercando un attuario parziale o quasi qualificato con forti capacità analitiche e capacità di produrre un lavoro tecnico di alta qualità. Il candidato ideale dimostrerà un approccio motivato, proattivo e flessibile, con la capacità di lavorare in modo efficace sia in modo indipendente che collaborativo all'interno del team di valutazione L&H e di gruppi interfunzionali più ampi.
Informazioni sul ruolo

Principali responsabilità
• Calcoli di riserva propri sotto più regimi di segnalazione (IFRS e Statutory), fornendo garanzia su accuratezza e driver di movimento chiave.
• Analisi del rapporto di ipotesi di piombo e del rapporto di perdita, gestione dei processi di governance e presentazione di raccomandazioni ai forum di livello esecutivo.
• Migliorare gli approcci di valutazione per i trattati materiali, tra cui l'implementazione di tecniche raffinate e il coordinamento con i team interfunzionali per garantire risultati robusti.
• Migliorare continuamente applicando competenze tecniche per risolvere problemi complessi, sfidare i processi esistenti e implementare soluzioni sostenibili.
• Mantenere la documentazione di qualità durante la fornitura di coaching e supporto tecnico ai membri del team junior.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Unisciti a un team diversificato e altamente qualificato che lavora in più sedi, uniti da obiettivi condivisi e da una stretta collaborazione. All'interno di Actuarial Reserving, siamo responsabili per la consegna tempestiva e accurata dei risultati finanziari trimestrali, fornendo allo stesso tempo chiare e attuabili informazioni sui driver chiave che interessano il portafoglio UK Life. Il nostro lavoro supporta la gestione senior identificando e rispondendo in modo proattivo alle aree di incertezza. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, collaboriamo a stretto contatto con i team di tutta la catena del valore di Life & Health, promuovendo relazioni forti che consentano di prendere decisioni consapevoli ed efficaci.
A proposito di te
Valoriamo le capacità di pensiero indipendente e problem solving, combinate con forti capacità di comunicazione per spiegare i concetti tecnici chiaramente ai diversi stakeholder. Il vostro approccio collaborativo, l'adattabilità e la curiosità naturale vi permetterà di supportare il team attraverso il cambiamento delle priorità, identificando le opportunità di miglioramento dei processi.
Chi stiamo cercando

• Attuario qualificato o quasi qualificato.

• Forte esperienza all'interno della riassicurazione / assicurazione, preferibilmente con un forte focus sulla valutazione e la segnalazione.

• Solida comprensione dei prodotti assicurativi Life & Health e delle strutture di riassicurazione, in particolare quelle scritte nel Regno Unito o in altri mercati europei.

• Competenze avanzate di Excel, con competenza nel software attuariale o statistico

• Pensatore indipendente e pragmatico, lavoro confortevole con ambiguità e proporre soluzioni efficaci e realizzabili allineando le aspettative con gli stakeholder.
Compensazione e modello di lavoro
L'intervallo di stipendio base per questa posizione è tra 62,000 GBP e 94,000 GBP (equivalente tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza
Modello di lavoro ibrido con un minimo di tre giorni a settimana in ufficio.
# Li-Hybrid #
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 14.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
This role sits within the UK Market Unit of the L&H Valuation EMEA team. You will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely reporting of the UK Life portfolio across multiple valuation bases. The role involves setting valuation assumptions and working closely with cross‑functional teams (XFTs) to deliver robust and compliant valuation outcomes.
We are seeking a part‑ or nearly qualified actuary with strong analytical skills and ability to produce high‑quality technical work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a motivated, proactive, and flexible approach, with the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within the L&H Valuation team and wider cross‑functional groups.
About the Role

Key Responsibilities
• Own reserve calculations under multiple reporting regimes (IFRS and Statutory), providing assurance on accuracy and key movement drivers.
• Lead assumption reviews and loss ratio analyses, managing governance processes and presenting recommendations to Executive-level forums.
• Enhance valuation approaches for material treaties, including implementing refined techniques and coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure robust outputs.
• Drive continuous improvement by applying technical expertise to resolve complex issues, challenging existing processes, and implementing sustainable solutions.
• Maintain quality documentation while providing coaching and technical support to junior team members.
About the Team
Join a diverse, highly skilled team working across multiple locations, united by shared objectives and close collaboration. Within Actuarial Reserving, we are responsible for the timely and accurate delivery of quarterly financial results, while providing clear, actionable insights into the key drivers affecting the UK Life portfolio. Our work supports senior management by proactively identifying and responding to areas of uncertainty. To achieve this, we partner closely with teams across the entire Life & Health value chain, fostering strong relationships that enable informed, effective decision‑making.
About You
We value independent thinking and problem-solving abilities, combined with strong communication skills to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders. Your collaborative approach, adaptability, and natural curiosity will enable you to support the team through changing priorities while identifying opportunities for process improvements.
Who we are looking for

• Qualified or near‑qualified Actuary.

• Strong experience within reinsurance/insurance, preferably with a strong focus on valuation and reporting.

• Solid understanding of Life & Health insurance products and reinsurance structures, particularly those written in the UK or other European markets.

• Advanced Excel skills, with proficiency in actuarial or statistical software

• Independent and pragmatic thinker, comfortable working with ambiguity and proposing effective, achievable solutions while aligning expectations with stakeholders.
Compensation & Work Model
The base salary range for this position is between 62,000 GBP and 94,000 GBP (full time equivalent). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
Hybrid working model with a minimum of three days per week in the office.
#Li-Hybrid
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Diese Rolle ist Teil der UK Market Unit des L&H Valuation EMEA Teams. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, eine genaue und zeitnahe Berichterstattung über das UK Life-Portfolio über mehrere Bewertungsbasen hinweg sicherzustellen. Die Aufgabe besteht darin, Bewertungsannahmen festzulegen und eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (XFTs) zusammenzuarbeiten, um robuste und konforme Bewertungsergebnisse zu liefern.
Wir suchen einen teil- oder nahezu qualifizierten versicherungsmathematiker mit starken analytischen fähigkeiten und der fähigkeit, qualitativ hochwertige technische arbeit zu produzieren. Der ideale Kandidat zeigt einen motivierten, proaktiven und flexiblen Ansatz mit der Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch kooperativ innerhalb des L & H Valuation-Teams und breiterer funktionsübergreifender Gruppen effektiv zu arbeiten.
Über die Rolle

Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Eigenreserveberechnungen im Rahmen mehrerer Meldesysteme (IFRS und Gesetz), die die Genauigkeit und die wichtigsten Bewegungstreiber gewährleisten.
• Leiten Sie Annahmeprüfungen und Verlustquotenanalysen, verwalten Sie Governance-Prozesse und präsentieren Sie Empfehlungen für Foren auf Führungsebene.
• Verbesserung der Bewertungsansätze für wesentliche Verträge, einschließlich der Implementierung verfeinerter Techniken und der Koordinierung mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um robuste Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.
• Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen, indem Sie technisches Know-how einsetzen, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen, bestehende Prozesse herauszufordern und nachhaltige Lösungen zu implementieren.
• Pflegen Sie die Qualitätsdokumentation und bieten Sie Coaching und technische Unterstützung für Junior-Teammitglieder.
Über das Team
Treten Sie einem vielfältigen, hochqualifizierten Team bei, das an mehreren Standorten arbeitet und gemeinsame Ziele und eine enge Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Bei Actuarial Reserving sind wir für die rechtzeitige und genaue Lieferung der Quartalsfinanzergebnisse verantwortlich und bieten gleichzeitig klare, umsetzbare Einblicke in die wichtigsten Treiber, die das UK Life-Portfolio beeinflussen. Unsere Arbeit unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung, indem wir proaktiv Unsicherheitsbereiche identifizieren und darauf reagieren. Um dies zu erreichen, arbeiten wir eng mit Teams entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von Life & Health zusammen und fördern starke Beziehungen, die eine fundierte und effektive Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen.
Über dich
Wir schätzen unabhängiges Denken und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, kombiniert mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um technische Konzepte verschiedenen Stakeholdern klar zu erklären. Ihr kooperativer Ansatz, Ihre Anpassungsfähigkeit und Ihre natürliche Neugier werden es Ihnen ermöglichen, das Team durch wechselnde Prioritäten zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig Möglichkeiten für Prozessverbesserungen zu identifizieren.
Wen wir suchen

• Qualifizierter oder nahezu qualifizierter Versicherungsmathematiker.

• Starke Erfahrung in der Rückversicherung / Versicherung, vorzugsweise mit einem starken Fokus auf Bewertung und Berichterstattung.

• Solides Verständnis von Lebens- und Krankenversicherungsprodukten und Rückversicherungsstrukturen, insbesondere derjenigen, die in Großbritannien oder anderen europäischen Märkten geschrieben wurden.

• Erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten, mit Kenntnissen in versicherungsmathematischer oder statistischer Software

• Unabhängiger und pragmatischer Denker, bequemes Arbeiten mit Mehrdeutigkeit und Vorschlagen effektiver, erreichbarer Lösungen, während die Erwartungen an die Stakeholder angepasst werden.
Vergütung & Arbeitsmodell
Die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt zwischen 62.000 GBP und 94.000 GBP (Vollzeitäquivalent). Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Verantwortlichkeiten der Rolle

• Eigenes Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche im Büro.

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Informazioni sul ruolo
Cerchiamo un Business Development Manager strategico e proattivo per aiutare la crescita nel nostro business di transazioni Life & Health (L&H), con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni strutturate e finanziarie e alle transazioni Full Risk Transfer.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Swiss Re Life & Health collabora con gli assicuratori in operazioni di riassicurazione su misura che affrontano il capitale, le sfide del mercato finanziario e il trasferimento dei rischi.
Il team L&H Business Development si trova all'estremità anteriore di questa catena di valore delle transazioni. Identifichiamo opportunità di transazione emergenti, sviluppiamo strategie di origine insieme alle nostre unità di mercato, Transaction Teams e clienti per trasformare le informazioni di mercato in soluzioni di riassicurazione innovative.
Questo ruolo offre un'esposizione significativa ai leader senior di Market Units e Transaction team, fornendo l'opportunità di influenzare le priorità strategiche e modellare la direzione futura del nostro business transazioni Life & Health. Vi aiuterete ad anticipare dove il mercato sta dirigendo e modellando la prossima generazione di transazioni attraverso iniziative strategiche e un impegno proattivo del cliente in stretta collaborazione con i creatori e i strutturatori.
Il nostro lavoro si concentra su tre aree chiave:
1. Trasformare le tendenze del mercato nelle opportunità di transazione
Trasformare gli sviluppi tra assicurazioni, mercati dei capitali e regolamentazione dalle esigenze del cliente in porta transazioni concrete
2. Guidare l'origine proattiva delle transazioni
Identificare e individuare attivamente nuove opportunità nei mercati assegnati, sviluppare narrazioni commerciali correlate e favorire il coinvolgimento allineato alle esigenze di capitale, gestione finanziaria e dei rischi dei clienti.
3. Avanzare iniziative di crescita strategica
Supporta iniziative e strategie di Business Unit ad alta priorità che espandono il nostro franchise di transazioni, rafforzano le capacità di origine e modellano il futuro delle transazioni di riassicurazione.
Le tue responsabilità chiave
• Sviluppare nuove opportunità di transazione Life & Health reinsurance in UK & Irlanda, EMEA e mercati globali selezionati, con un focus sulle soluzioni strutturate e finanziarie e sulle transazioni Full Risk Transfer.
• Partner con Transaction Originators, Structured Solutions, Market Units e altri esperti tecnici per modellare e guidare l'origine di operazioni di riassicurazione innovative.
• Creare una profonda comprensione degli obiettivi strategici, finanziari e finanziari dei clienti e delle proposte differenziate di valore che rispondono alle loro esigenze in evoluzione.
• Anticipare gli sviluppi normativi, macroeconomici e industriali e tradurre le intuizioni di mercato in opportunità di transazione commercialmente convincenti e proposizioni dei clienti.
• Influenza e collaborazione in Swiss Re per rafforzare le nostre capacità di transazione, sviluppare nuove soluzioni client e anticipare la nostra proposta di transazione.
• Agire come collaboratore senior, costruire relazioni di fiducia tra gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, mentre guida iniziative strategiche senza responsabilità di gestione diretta delle persone
• Ti riferirai direttamente al capo dello sviluppo commerciale L&H.
Cosa stiamo cercando:
• 8+ anni di esperienza in Life & Health re/insurance, con comprovata esperienza in complesse operazioni di riassicurazione o soluzioni di capitale.
• Una mentalità proattiva e imprenditoriale con la passione per l'identificazione delle opportunità, spingendo i confini, sviluppando i casi di business e creando valore cliente a lungo termine.
• Dimostrata capacità di tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in proposizioni client commercialmente convincenti e opportunità di business strategiche.
• Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior e collaborare efficacemente tra team multidisciplinari, tra cui i mercati dei clienti, strutturazione, sottoscrizione e funzioni attuariali.
• Forte competenza tecnica in attuariale, gestione del capitale, soluzioni strutturate o riassicurazione finanziaria, combinate con una mentalità commerciale.
• Solida comprensione dei prodotti Life & Health reinsurance in UK&I o EMEA
• Forte comprensione del trattamento di riassicurazione ai sensi di Solvency II, IFRS e/o di altri quadri di capitale o di contabilità rilevanti.
• Laurea in scienze attuariali, matematica, finanza, economia o una disciplina relativa.
Su di noi
Questa è la vostra occasione per aderire Swiss Re Group - uno dei principali fornitori all'ingrosso al mondo di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme innovative di trasferimento di rischio basato sulle assicurazioni. La nostra attività di Swiss Re è la comprensione e l'analisi dei principali rischi che riguardano il mondo - dalle catastrofi naturali ai cambiamenti climatici, dall'invecchiamento delle popolazioni al cybercrimine. Uniamo esperienza con competenze e pensiero innovativo per creare nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. E permettiamo al rischio essenziale di impresa e progresso.
Questo è possibile solo con circa 15.000 persone Swiss Re veramente eccezionali in tutto il nostro gruppo in tutto il mondo.
#LI-HYBRID #
Compensazione e modello di lavoro
La fascia salariale per questa posizione è GBP 90.000 - GBP 134.000 (equivalente a tempo pieno), a seconda dell'esperienza, delle qualifiche, delle competenze e della portata del ruolo.
Noi op cancellare un modello di lavoro ibrido, con un minimo di tre giorni alla settimana in ufficio.
Forniamo feedback a tutti i candidati via e-mail. Se non hai ricevuto una risposta, controlla la cartella spam.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro e alla loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

About the role
We're looking for a strategic and proactive Business Development Manager to help drive growth in our Life & Health (L&H) transaction business, with a particular focus on Structured and Financial Solutions and Full Risk Transfer Transactions.
About the Team
Swiss Re Life & Health partners with insurers on bespoke reinsurance transactions that address capital, financial market challenges and risk transfer.
The L&H Business Development team sits at the front end of this transaction value chain. We identify emerging transaction opportunities, develop origination strategies together with our Market Units, Transaction Teams and clients to turn market insights into innovative reinsurance solutions.
This role offers significant exposure to senior leaders across Market Units and Transaction teams, providing the opportunity to influence strategic priorities and shape the future direction of our Life & Health transaction business. You'll help anticipate where the market is heading and shape the next generation of transactions through strategic initiatives and proactive client engagement in close collaboration with originators and structurers.
Our work focuses on three key areas:
1. Transform market trends into transaction opportunities
Turn developments across insurance, capital markets and regulation from client needs into concrete transaction leads
2. Drive proactive transaction origination
Proactively identify and target new opportunities across assigned markets, develop related commercial narrative and foster engagement aligned to clients' capital, financial and risk management needs.
3. Advance strategic growth initiatives
Support high-priority Business Unit initiatives and strategies that expand our transaction franchise, strengthen origination capabilities and shape the future of reinsurance transactions.
Your Key Responsibilities
•  Develop new Life & Health reinsurance transaction opportunities across UK & Ireland, EMEA and selected global markets, with a focus on Structured and Financial Solutions and Full Risk Transfer transactions.
•  Partner with Transaction Originators, Structured Solutions, Market Units and other technical experts to shape and drive origination of innovative reinsurance transactions.
•  Create deep understanding of clients' strategic, capital and financial objectives, and shape differentiated value propositions that address their evolving needs.
•  Anticipate regulatory, macroeconomic and industry developments and translate market insights into commercially compelling transaction opportunities and client propositions.
•  Influence and collaborate across Swiss Re to strengthen our transaction capabilities, develop new client solutions and advance our transaction proposition.
•  Act as a senior contributor, building trusted relationships across internal and external stakeholders while driving strategic initiatives without direct people management responsibility
• You will report directly to the Head of L&H Business Development.
What We’re Looking For:
•  8+ years of experience in Life & Health re/insurance, with proven experience in  complex reinsurance or capital solutions transactions.
•  A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for identifying opportunities, pushing boundaries, developing business cases and creating long-term client value.
•  Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into commercially compelling client propositions and strategic business opportunities.
•  Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams, including client markets, structuring, underwriting and actuarial functions.
•  Strong technical expertise in actuarial, capital management, structured solutions or financial reinsurance, combined with a commercial mindset.
•  Solid understanding of Life & Health reinsurance products in in UK&I or EMEA
•  Strong understanding of reinsurance treatment under Solvency II, IFRS and/or other relevant capital or accounting frameworks.
•  Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
About us
This is your opportunity to join Swiss Re Group - one of the world's leading wholesale providers of reinsurance, insurance and other innovative forms of insurance-based risk transfer. Our business at Swiss Re is about understanding and analysing the major risks that concern the world - from natural catastrophes to climate change, from ageing populations to cybercrime. We combine experience with expertise and innovative thinking to create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. And we enable the risk-taking essential to enterprise and progress.
This is only possible with around 15,000 truly exceptional Swiss Re people across our group worldwide.
#LI-HYBRID
Compensation & Work Model
The salary range for this position is GBP 90,000 - GBP 134,000 (full-time equivalent), depending on experience, qualifications, skills, and the scope of the role.
We op erate a hybrid working model, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.
We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not received a response, please check your spam folder.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen nach einem strategischen und proaktiven Business Development Manager, der das Wachstum unseres Life & Health (L&H)-Transaktionsgeschäfts vorantreibt, mit besonderem Fokus auf strukturierte und finanzielle Lösungen und vollständige Risikotransfertransaktionen.
Über das Team
Swiss Re Life & Health kooperiert mit Versicherern bei maßgeschneiderten Rückversicherungstransaktionen, die sich mit Kapital, Finanzmarktherausforderungen und Risikotransfer befassen.
Das L&H Business Development Team sitzt am vorderen Ende dieser Transaktions-Wertschöpfungskette. Wir identifizieren neue Transaktionsmöglichkeiten, entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Market Units, Transaktionsteams und Kunden Originationsstrategien, um Markteinblicke in innovative Rückversicherungslösungen umzuwandeln.
Diese Rolle bietet eine signifikante Präsenz gegenüber leitenden Führungskräften in Market Units und Transaktionsteams und bietet die Möglichkeit, strategische Prioritäten zu beeinflussen und die zukünftige Ausrichtung unseres Life & Health-Transaktionsgeschäfts zu gestalten. Sie helfen dabei, vorauszusehen, wohin der Markt geht, und gestalten die nächste Generation von Transaktionen durch strategische Initiativen und proaktives Kundenengagement in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Originatoren und Strukturierern.
Unsere Arbeit konzentriert sich auf drei Schlüsselbereiche:
1. Transformation von Markttrends in Transaktionsmöglichkeiten
Verwandeln Sie Entwicklungen über Versicherungen, Kapitalmärkte und Regulierung hinweg von Kundenbedürfnissen in konkrete Transaktionsleiter
2. Proaktive Transaktionsgenerierung vorantreiben
Proaktives Erkennen und Anvisieren neuer Chancen in zugewiesenen Märkten, Entwicklung entsprechender kommerzieller Erzählungen und Förderung des Engagements, das auf die Kapital-, Finanz- und Risikomanagementanforderungen der Kunden ausgerichtet ist.
3. Strategische Wachstumsinitiativen vorantreiben
Unterstützen Sie vorrangige Business Unit-Initiativen und Strategien, die unser Transaktions-Franchise erweitern, die Originationsfähigkeit stärken und die Zukunft von Rückversicherungstransaktionen gestalten.
Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben
• Entwicklung neuer Möglichkeiten für Life & Health-Rückversicherungstransaktionen in Großbritannien und Irland, EMEA und ausgewählten globalen Märkten mit Schwerpunkt auf strukturierten und Finanzlösungen sowie Transaktionen mit vollem Risikotransfer.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Transaction Originators, Structured Solutions, Market Units und anderen technischen Experten, um innovative Rückversicherungstransaktionen zu gestalten und voranzutreiben.
• Schaffen Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der strategischen, Kapital- und Finanzziele der Kunden und gestalten Sie differenzierte Wertversprechen, die auf ihre sich entwickelnden Bedürfnisse eingehen.
• Antizipieren Sie regulatorische, makroökonomische und branchenspezifische Entwicklungen und übersetzen Sie Markterkenntnisse in kommerziell attraktive Transaktionsmöglichkeiten und Kundenangebote.
• Einfluss nehmen und bei Swiss Re zusammenarbeiten, um unsere Transaktionsfähigkeiten zu stärken, neue Kundenlösungen zu entwickeln und unser Transaktionsangebot voranzutreiben.
• Handeln Sie als Senior Contributor, bauen Sie vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen zwischen internen und externen Stakeholdern auf und fördern Sie strategische Initiativen ohne direkte Verantwortung für das Personalmanagement
• Sie berichten direkt an den Head of L&H Business Development.
Was wir suchen:
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in Life & Health Rück-/Versicherung, mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in komplexen Rückversicherungs- oder Kapitallösungstransaktionen.
• Eine proaktive, unternehmerische Denkweise mit einer Leidenschaft dafür, Chancen zu erkennen, Grenzen zu überschreiten, Geschäftsfälle zu entwickeln und langfristigen Kundenwert zu schaffen.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte in kommerziell überzeugende Kundenvorschläge und strategische Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu übersetzen.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, leitende Stakeholder zu beeinflussen und effektiv in multidisziplinären Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, einschließlich Kundenmärkten, Strukturierung, Zeichnung und versicherungsmathematischen Funktionen.
• Starkes technisches Know-how in den Bereichen Versicherungsmathematik, Kapitalmanagement, strukturierte Lösungen oder Finanzrückversicherung, kombiniert mit einer kaufmännischen Denkweise.
• Solides Verständnis von Life & Health-Rückversicherungsprodukten in Großbritannien & I oder EMEA
• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der Behandlung von Rückversicherungen nach Solvency II, IFRS und/oder anderen relevanten Kapital- oder Rechnungslegungsrahmen.
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Aktuarwissenschaften, Mathematik, Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin.
Über uns
Dies ist Ihre Chance, der Swiss Re Group beizutreten - einem der weltweit führenden Großhandelsanbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen innovativen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers. Bei Swiss Re geht es darum, die wichtigsten Risiken zu verstehen und zu analysieren, die die Welt betreffen - von Naturkatastrophen bis zum Klimawandel, von alternden Bevölkerungen bis hin zur Cyberkriminalität. Wir kombinieren Erfahrung mit Know-how und innovativem Denken, um neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Und wir ermöglichen die Risikobereitschaft, die für Unternehmen und Fortschritt unerlässlich ist.
Dies ist nur mit rund 15.000 wirklich außergewöhnlichen Swiss Re Mitarbeitern in unserer Gruppe weltweit möglich.
#LI-HYBRID
Vergütung & Arbeitsmodell
Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt GBP 90.000 - GBP 134.000 (Vollzeitäquivalent), abhängig von Erfahrung, Qualifikationen, Fähigkeiten und dem Umfang der Rolle.
Wir betreiben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche im Büro.
Wir geben allen Kandidaten Feedback per E-Mail. Wenn Sie keine Antwort erhalten haben, überprüfen Sie bitte Ihren Spam-Ordner.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

Sur le rôle
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire stratégique et proactif du développement des entreprises pour aider à stimuler la croissance de nos opérations sur la vie et la santé (L&H), en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les solutions structurées et financières et les opérations de transfert à risque complet.
À propos de l'équipe
Swiss Re Life & Health s'associe aux assureurs pour des opérations de réassurance sur mesure qui traitent des problèmes de capitaux, de marchés financiers et de transfert de risques.
L'équipe de développement des entreprises de L&H se trouve à l'avant de cette chaîne de valeur des transactions. Nous identifions les nouvelles possibilités de transaction, développons des stratégies d'origine avec nos unités de marché, nos équipes de transaction et nos clients afin de transformer les perspectives du marché en solutions de réassurance innovantes.
Ce rôle offre une grande visibilité aux cadres supérieurs de l'ensemble des équipes d'unités de marché et d'opérations, offrant l'occasion d'influer sur les priorités stratégiques et de façonner l'orientation future de nos opérations sur la vie et la santé. Vous aiderez à anticiper l'orientation du marché et à façonner la prochaine génération de transactions grâce à des initiatives stratégiques et à l'engagement proactif des clients en étroite collaboration avec les initiateurs et les structurants.
Notre travail porte sur trois domaines clés :
1. Transformer les tendances du marché en possibilités de transaction
Transformer l'évolution des marchés des assurances, des capitaux et de la réglementation des besoins des clients en pistes de transactions concrètes
2. Favoriser l'origine proactive des transactions
Déterminer et cibler de façon proactive les nouvelles possibilités dans les marchés désignés, élaborer des descriptions commerciales connexes et favoriser l'engagement en fonction des besoins des clients en capital, en finances et en gestion des risques.
3. Promouvoir les initiatives stratégiques de croissance
Soutenir les initiatives et les stratégies hautement prioritaires de l'unité commerciale qui élargissent notre franchise de transaction, renforcent les capacités d'origine et façonnent l'avenir des opérations de réassurance.
Vos principales responsabilités
• Développer de nouvelles opportunités d'opérations de réassurance Life & Health à travers le Royaume-Uni et l'Irlande, l'EMEA et certains marchés mondiaux, en mettant l'accent sur les solutions structurées et financières et les transactions de transfert à risque complet.
• Partenaire avec les fournisseurs de transactions, les solutions structurées, les unités de marché et d'autres experts techniques pour façonner et diriger l'origine des transactions de réassurance innovantes.
• Créer une compréhension approfondie des objectifs stratégiques, financiers et financiers des clients, et façonner des propositions de valeur différenciées qui répondent à leurs besoins en évolution.
• Anticiper l'évolution de la réglementation, de la macroéconomie et de l'industrie et traduire les perspectives du marché en possibilités de transaction commercialement convaincantes et en propositions de clients.
• Influencer et collaborer dans Swiss Re pour renforcer nos capacités de transaction, développer de nouvelles solutions client et faire avancer notre proposition de transaction.
• Agir en tant que contributeur principal, établir des relations de confiance entre les intervenants internes et externes tout en menant des initiatives stratégiques sans responsabilité directe de gestion des personnes
• Vous relèverez directement du chef du Développement des affaires de L&H.
Ce que nous cherchons:
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en réassurance/assurance Life & Health, avec une expérience éprouvée dans des opérations complexes de réassurance ou de solutions de capital.
• Un esprit d'entreprise proactif et passionné pour identifier les possibilités, repousser les frontières, développer des analyses de rentabilisation et créer une valeur cliente à long terme.
• Capacité démontrée de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en propositions de clients et en occasions stratégiques.
• Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les principaux intervenants et de collaborer efficacement entre les équipes multidisciplinaires, y compris les marchés clients, la structuration, la souscription et les fonctions actuarielles.
• Une solide expertise technique dans les domaines de l'actuariat, de la gestion du capital, des solutions structurées ou de la réassurance financière, associée à une mentalité commerciale.
• Une bonne compréhension des produits de réassurance Life & Health au Royaume-Uni et dans l'EMEA
• Une bonne compréhension du traitement de réassurance dans le cadre de Solvabilité II, des IFRS et/ou d'autres cadres financiers ou comptables pertinents.
• Baccalauréat en sciences actuarielles, mathématiques, finances, économie ou une discipline connexe.
À propos de nous
C'est l'occasion pour vous de rejoindre Swiss Re Group, l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes innovantes de transfert de risques fondé sur l'assurance. Notre activité chez Swiss Re est de comprendre et d'analyser les risques majeurs qui touchent le monde - des catastrophes naturelles au changement climatique, du vieillissement des populations à la cybercriminalité. Nous combinons expérience et expertise et pensée innovante pour créer de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Et nous permettons la prise de risque essentielle à l'entreprise et au progrès.
Cela n'est possible qu'avec environ 15 000 personnes Swiss Re vraiment exceptionnelles dans notre groupe mondial.
#LI-HYBRID
Modèle de rémunération et de travail
L'échelle salariale pour ce poste est de GBP 90 000 - GBP 134 000 (équivalent temps plein), selon l'expérience, les qualifications, les compétences et l'étendue du rôle.

Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque basé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, allant des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive qui encourage de nouvelles perspectives et des idées novatrices. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, indépendamment de son âge, de son sexe, de sa race, de son appartenance ethnique, de son identité et/ou de son expression, de son orientation sexuelle, de ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, de ses compétences, de sa pensée ou de toute autre caractéristique. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, chacun peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.

P&C Contracts fa parte di Underwriting Excellence in Property & Casualty Reinsurance . È responsabile dell’assicurare che gli accordi di assicurazione Swiss Re (re) siano conformi agli standard di sottoscrizione e di contratti.

Le responsabilità principali dell'esperto/contratto di assicurazione sono:

Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Job Description – Reinsurance Contracts Expert [Mumbai, India]
Head of P&C Reinsurance Contracts, Asia Pacific is seeking a regional Reinsurance contract wordings counsel / expert to join our team supporting Swiss Re's property and casualty ("P&C") reinsurance business in the India region. Primary responsibilities include drafting and review of (re)insurance contract wordings, advising on contract related matters, and engaging with internal and, at times, external clients to negotiate and finalize the terms of reinsurance contracts, as well as supporting the Head of P&C Reinsurance Contracts to manage contract risks in reinsurance portfolio. This position will be based in Mumbai.
About the team
P&C Contracts is part of Underwriting Excellence in Property & Casualty Reinsurance . It is responsible for ensuring Swiss Re (re)insurance agreements comply with underwriting and contracts standards.
In P&C Contracts, you will join a highly engaged global team of approximately 40 legal / claims / underwriting experts and specialists who support all Lines of Property, Casualty, and Specialty business. Primary responsibilities of our Contracts Function include drafting and review of (re)insurance wordings, advising on contract related matters and engaging with internal and external clients to negotiate and finalize the terms of reinsurance contracts as well as the further development of our tool landscape and wording analytics.
Core responsibilities of the Reinsurance Contracts Expert / Counsel are:

• Independently draft and critique (re)insurance contracts, binders, slips, endorsements and related documents to align written agreements with business intent and corporate requirement.

• Perform portfolio analysis and provide insights on trends related to contract risks, in reliance on Swiss Re contracts systems and database.

• Align reinsurance contracts with applicable law, regulations and internal requirements.

• Coordinate, communicate and participate in development of corporate policies on contract related matters.

• Support functional development of contract management and analytical systems;

• Collaborate with Client Managers and Underwriters in contract negotiations, including discussions with external clients and brokers in the India market.

• Act as expert technical advisor, providing guidance to various corporate functions regarding contract formation / interpretation, implications of particular contract language and best practices.

• Develop training materials and deliver internal, external or public training on contract related matters; drive thought leadership on contract certainty.

• Maintain strong governance risk and control standards with respect to contract wordings and processes.
The successful candidate will be expected to develop a thorough understanding of relevant law, regulations and market practices in the Asia Pacific region and apply these to (re)insurance agreements. Participation in Global projects / initiatives through co-working with team mates from the US and EMEA Regions is expected. They will also require strong analytical abilities, experience in business negotiations, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to engage confidently and in an impactful manner with internal stakeholders and clients. We are seeking a candidate with an innovative, pragmatic and results-oriented mindset, who possesses the ability to work independently with a sense of personal responsibility and accountability, while also building cooperative relationships with internal and external partners, to enable cross-functional team decision making in alignment with Swiss Re business strategy. The Contracts Expert / Counsel should be available for business travel roughly two weeks each year.
Requirements for the Reinsurance Contracts Expert / Counsel position include:

• Degree holder in business, finance, insurance, law or a related field; preferably with professional insurance designation (e.g. ACII or equivalent); legal background / qualification in common / English law an advantage;

• 5 or more years of (re)insurance industry experience (re)insurance claims, underwriting, coverage counsel, legal or product role;

• Solid understanding of P&C (re)insurance policy wordings, coverage, product, and business processes;

• Good skill and confidence in commercial / (re)insurance coverage agreement drafting;

• External customer servicing, management, or advising experience an advantage;

• Exposure to a multi-cultural work and / or client servicing environment; and

• High level fluency in English

• Effective computer and Information Technology literacy.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Über das Team
P&C Contracts ist Teil von Underwriting Excellence in Property & Casualty Reinsurance. Sie ist dafür verantwortlich, dass Swiss Re (Rück-)Versicherungsverträge den Standards für Zeichnungen und Verträge entsprechen.
Bei P&C Contracts treten Sie einem hoch engagierten globalen Team von rund 40 Rechts- / Schadens- / Underwriting-Experten und Spezialisten bei, die alle Bereiche Immobilien, Unfall- und Spezialgeschäfte unterstützen. Zu den Hauptaufgaben unserer Vertragsfunktion gehören die Erstellung und Überprüfung von (Rück-)Versicherungsformeln, die Beratung in vertragsrelevanten Angelegenheiten und die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Kunden bei der Aushandlung und Fertigstellung der Bedingungen von Rückversicherungsverträgen sowie die Weiterentwicklung unserer Toollandschaft und Wording Analytics.
Kernaufgaben des Rückversicherungsvertragsexperten / Beraters sind:

• Koordinieren, kommunizieren und beteiligen Sie sich an der Entwicklung der Unternehmenspolitik in vertragsbezogenen Angelegenheiten.

• Unterstützung der funktionalen Entwicklung von Vertragsmanagement- und Analysesystemen;

• Zusammenarbeit mit Kundenmanagern und Underwritern in Vertragsverhandlungen, einschließlich Diskussionen mit externen Kunden und Brokern auf dem indischen Markt.

• Handeln Sie als kompetenter technischer Berater und unterstützen Sie verschiedene Unternehmensfunktionen in Bezug auf die Vertragsbildung / -interpretation, die Auswirkungen einer bestimmten Vertragssprache und Best Practices.

• Entwicklung von Schulungsmaterialien und Bereitstellung interner, externer oder öffentlicher Schulungen zu vertragsbezogenen Fragen; Vordenker in Bezug auf Vertragssicherheit.

• Bewahren Sie strenge Governance-Risiko- und Kontrollstandards in Bezug auf Vertragsformulierungen und -prozesse auf.
Von dem erfolgreichen Kandidaten wird erwartet, dass er ein gründliches Verständnis der relevanten Gesetze, Vorschriften und Marktpraktiken in der Region Asien-Pazifik entwickelt und diese auf (Rück-)Versicherungsvereinbarungen anwendet. Die Teilnahme an globalen Projekten / Initiativen durch Zusammenarbeit mit Teamkollegen aus den USA und den EMEA-Regionen wird erwartet. Sie erfordern auch starke analytische Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung in Geschäftsverhandlungen und hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, sich mit internen Stakeholdern und Kunden vertrauensvoll und wirkungsvoll auseinanderzusetzen. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit einer innovativen, pragmatischen und ergebnisorientierten Denkweise, der die Fähigkeit besitzt, eigenverantwortlich und verantwortungsbewusst zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig kooperative Beziehungen zu internen und externen Partnern aufzubauen, um funktionsübergreifende Teamentscheidungen in Übereinstimmung mit der Geschäftsstrategie von Swiss Re zu ermöglichen. Der Vertragsexperte / Counsel sollte für Geschäftsreisen ungefähr zwei Wochen pro Jahr zur Verfügung stehen.
Die Anforderungen an die Position des Experten / Beraters für Rückversicherungsverträge umfassen:

• Inhaber eines Abschlusses in Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Versicherungen, Recht oder einem verwandten Bereich; vorzugsweise mit professioneller Versicherungsbezeichnung (z. B. ACII oder gleichwertig); Rechtshintergrund / Qualifikation im allgemeinen / englischen Recht ein Vorteil;

• 5 oder mehr Jahre (Rück-)Versicherung Branchenerfahrung (Rück-)Versicherungsansprüche, Underwriting, Coverage Counsel, rechtliche oder Produktrolle;

• Solides Verständnis der P&C (Rück-)Versicherungspolitik Formulierungen, Abdeckung, Produkt und Geschäftsprozesse;

• Gute Fähigkeiten und Vertrauen in die Erstellung von Geschäfts- / (Rück-)Versicherungsverträgen;

• Externe Kundenbetreuung, Management oder Beratung Erfahrung ein Vorteil;

• Exposition gegenüber einer multikulturellen Arbeits- und / oder Kundendienstumgebung; und

• Hoch fließend in Englisch

• Effektive Computer- und Informationstechnologiekompetenz.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir begrüßen einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Chef des contrats de réassurance de P&C, Asie-Pacifique cherche un conseiller / expert régional pour rejoindre notre équipe soutenant l'entreprise de réassurance de Swiss Re dans la région de l'Inde. Les principales responsabilités comprennent la rédaction et l'examen de la formulation des contrats d'assurance (re)s, la prestation de conseils sur les questions liées aux contrats et la collaboration avec les clients internes et, parfois, externes pour négocier et finaliser les clauses des contrats de réassurance, ainsi que l'appui au chef des contrats de réassurance de P&C pour gérer les risques contractuels dans le portefeuille de réassurance. Cette position sera basée à Mumbai.
À propos de l'équipe
Les contrats de P&C font partie de l'excellence de souscription en réassurance de biens et pertes . Il est chargé de veiller à ce que les contrats d'assurance suisse soient conformes aux normes de souscription et de contrat.
Dans les contrats P&C, vous rejoindrez une équipe mondiale très engagée d'environ 40 experts en droit / réclamations / souscription et des spécialistes qui soutiennent toutes les lignes de propriété, les pertes et les affaires spécialisées. Les principales responsabilités de notre fonction Contrats comprennent la rédaction et l'examen de libellés (re)assurance, des conseils sur les questions liées aux contrats et la collaboration avec les clients internes et externes pour négocier et finaliser les termes des contrats de réassurance ainsi que le développement ultérieur de notre paysage d'outils et d'analyse de libellé.
Les principales responsabilités de l'expert/conseil en contrats de réassurance sont les suivantes :

• Ébauche et critique indépendantes des contrats d'assurance, des classeurs, des feuillets, des endossements et des documents connexes afin d'harmoniser les ententes écrites avec l'intention de l'entreprise et les exigences de l'entreprise.

• Coordonner, communiquer et participer à l'élaboration des politiques ministérielles sur les questions liées aux marchés.

• Soutenir le développement fonctionnel des systèmes de gestion des contrats et d'analyse;

• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de clients et les assureurs dans les négociations contractuelles, y compris les discussions avec les clients et les courtiers externes sur le marché indien.

• Agir à titre de conseiller technique expert, en fournissant des conseils à diverses fonctions ministérielles concernant la formation et l'interprétation des contrats, les répercussions d'un langage particulier du contrat et les pratiques exemplaires.

• Maintenir de solides normes de risque et de contrôle en matière de gouvernance en ce qui concerne la formulation des contrats et les processus.
On s'attend à ce que le candidat retenu comprenne bien les lois, règlements et pratiques de marché pertinents dans la région Asie-Pacifique et les applique aux accords de (re)assurance. La participation à des projets/initiatives mondiaux par le biais d'une collaboration avec des partenaires des régions des États-Unis et de l'EMEA est attendue. Nous recherchons un candidat avec un état d'esprit innovant, pragmatique et axé sur les résultats, qui possède la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante avec un sens de responsabilité personnelle et de responsabilité, tout en établissant des relations de coopération avec des partenaires internes et externes, pour permettre une prise de décision interfonctionnelle en adéquation avec la stratégie commerciale Swiss Re. L'expert/conseil en contrats devrait être disponible pour les voyages d'affaires environ deux semaines par année.
Exigences relatives au poste d'expert/avocat en contrats de réassurance :

• Titulaire d'un diplôme en affaires, finance, assurance, droit ou un domaine connexe; de préférence avec une désignation d'assurance professionnelle (p. ex. ACII ou équivalent); expérience juridique / qualification en droit commun / anglais un avantage;

• 5 années ou plus d'expérience (ré)assurance de l'industrie (ré)assurance, souscription, conseil de couverture, rôle juridique ou produit;

• le service à la clientèle externe, la gestion ou l'expérience de conseil un avantage;

• l'exposition à un environnement de travail multiculturel et/ou de service à la clientèle;

• Haute maîtrise de l'anglais

About the Role:
As a Credit & Surveillance Analyst within our Credit Risk Management (CRM) team, you will play apivotal role in safeguarding Swiss Re's financial strength and reputation. This is not your averagerisk role — you'll blend independent credit analysis with cutting-edge data science techniques tobuild scalable tools, uncover meaningful insights, and support high-stakes decision-making at asenior level. Your work will have real, visible impact across Swiss Re's entire business spectrum.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and implement quantitative tools to enhance scalability, consistency, and insightgeneration across credit risk assessments

• Apply data science techniques to improve speed, efficiency, and the quality of analyticaloutputs

• Work with complex datasets to extract meaningful patterns and support robust riskdecision-making

• Drive automation initiatives for recurring analyses and reporting processes, freeing upcapacity for higher-value, strategic work

• Perform independent quantitative and qualitative credit risk analysis on individualcounterparties across the global insurance sector

• Develop and deliver well-reasoned ratings and limit recommendations for seniormanagement decision-making

• Create concise, decision-oriented analysis on complex credit exposures and transaction-related risk assessments

• Monitor credit developments and engage proactively with internal stakeholders on emergingrisks

• Develop a solid understanding of financial risk calculations associated with key insuranceproducts and effectively communicate methodologies to business units
About the Team:
Credit risk is woven into the fabric of the Swiss Re Group — spanning credit counterparty risksembedded in structured transactions across Property & Casualty and Life & Health reinsurance,Alternative Risk Transfer solutions, Asset Management investment strategies, Credit & Suretyunderwriting activities, and corporate finance operations including custodial, banking, andderivatives counterparties.
The CRM Insurance team is the specialist unit responsible for identifying, measuring, monitoring,and controlling credit default and migration risk on insurance counterparties. We ensure thatSwiss Re's credit risk profile remains transparent to management and appropriately aligned withits risk appetite. Our team members are based across Zurich, New York, Alpharetta, andBangalore, working in close collaboration across time zones to deliver consistent, high-qualityrisk oversight on a global scale.
About You:
You are a quantitatively-minded professional who finds energy in transforming complex data intoclear, actionable insights. You bring proven analytical capabilities alongside strongcommunication skills — able to translate technical findings into compelling businessrecommendations. Naturally curious and detail-oriented, you thrive in collaborative environmentswhere your work has real, visible impact. You approach challenges with intellectual rigor,embrace continuous learning, and are energized by the opportunity to contribute to a globallyrespected risk management function.
We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• Strong quantitative and analytical background with solid academic credentials in a relevantfield such as Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline

• Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing production-ready analytical toolsor data-driven frameworks in a business or risk environment

• Advanced programming skills in Python, R, or Power BI, with demonstrated ability to deliverscalable solutions

• 2–5 years of relevant experience in financial risk assessment, data analysis, or relatedfields

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex technical findings clearlyto both technical and non-technical audiences
These Are Additional Nice to Haves:

• Experience in credit risk assessment, capital markets analysis, or financial institutionscoverage

• Knowledge of credit rating methodologies and risk assessment frameworks

• Familiarity with financial statement analysis and credit modeling techniques

• Experience working within a global or matrix organization

• Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or similar
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office atleast three days per week.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you analytically minded and passionate about credit risk? Do you thrive in an international environment where sharp thinking meets meaningful client relationships? At Swiss Re, we bring together deep underwriting expertise and a global perspective — and we are looking for a curious, motivated individual ready to make their mark in Credit & Surety Reinsurance across Europe.
If you enjoy analysing credit risks, exercising sound judgement, collaborating with talented colleagues and engaging with clients across diverse markets, this could be the opportunity you have been looking for.
About the Role
This is your chance to join Swiss Re's Credit & Surety Reinsurance Europe team in Frankfurt and grow your underwriting expertise in one of the most specialised and intellectually stimulating areas of the reinsurance industry.
You will actively assess and underwrite treaty and facultative reinsurance opportunities, working closely with experienced underwriters and specialists. You will take ownership of selected risks, accounts and client interactions, while building a deep understanding of credit risk, reinsurance structures and portfolio management. The role offers a genuine opportunity to develop both your technical underwriting capabilities and your commercial acumen in a truly international setting.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyse and assess treaty and facultative reinsurance opportunities, evaluating risk profiles, exposures and expected profitability, and conducting appropriate costing

• Prepare high-quality underwriting analyses and recommendations in line with Swiss Re's risk appetite, underwriting guidelines and governance framework

• Negotiate reinsurance terms and conditions with clients and brokers, collaborating with underwriting colleagues as needed

• Make underwriting recommendations and decisions within the applicable authority framework and take ownership of selected risks and accounts

• Develop and nurture relationships with insurance clients, brokers and other market participants, and contribute to gathering relevant market and client intelligence

• Monitor market developments , emerging risks and portfolio performance to support sound and informed underwriting decisions

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Client Markets, Credit Risk Management, Claims, Contracts, Business Services and Finance to support effective end-to-end execution
About the Team
Credit & Surety Reinsurance at Swiss Re provides tailored reinsurance solutions to insurers writing Trade Credit, Surety and Political Risk business across the globe. Our Europe team is a highly international group working with leading insurers across a diverse range of markets, products and client segments.
As part of the team, you will work alongside underwriting professionals and specialists in a collaborative environment that values knowledge-sharing, intellectual curiosity and continuous development. You will also gain exposure to colleagues and specialists across Swiss Re's global network — providing an excellent platform to deepen your technical expertise, commercial understanding and professional network.
About You
You are curious, analytical and commercially minded, with a genuine interest in underwriting and credit risk. You enjoy understanding businesses, interpreting financial information and translating economic developments into clear, well-reasoned underwriting recommendations. You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and exchanging perspectives with colleagues across cultures and functions.
You take responsibility for your work, apply sound judgement and are ready to explain and stand behind your underwriting assessments. You combine attention to detail with an appreciation of the broader commercial context — and you are motivated to grow into a well-rounded Credit & Surety underwriting professional.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Academic background in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Law or a related discipline

• Ideally around three years of professional experience in an underwriting-related or credit risk position; we also welcome candidates with a strong academic background or experience in roles involving financial, commercial or legal risk assessment

• Strong analytical and conceptual skills , with a solid understanding of or demonstrated interest in credit risk, financial analysis and underwriting

• Ability to analyse information in a structured way , identify key risk drivers and communicate conclusions clearly and confidently

• Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across teams, functions and cultures

• A proactive approach , intellectual curiosity and a genuine willingness to learn and take on increasing responsibility

• Proficient English , with strong written and verbal communication skills

• Willingness to travel occasionally to meet clients and attend industry events
These are additional nice to haves:

• Initial exposure to Credit & Surety insurance or reinsurance , or credit risk management

• Relevant professional experience in a legal environment , particularly in commercial, banking, finance, insurance, insolvency or contract law, involving the assessment of contractual, financial or credit-related matters

• Understanding of financial statements and credit analysis

• Familiarity with European insurance or financial services markets

• Additional European language skills would be a valuable asset in our pan-European client environment
Compensation
For Germany, the base salary range for this position is between 71 000 EUR and 118 000 EUR for a full-time role.
The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Furthermore, you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients.
