Êtes-vous un avocat qualifié avec une passion pour la réassurance complexe, innovante et les transactions de capital alternatives? Propulsez-vous dans un environnement collaboratif et international où votre expertise juridique façonne de véritables résultats commerciaux? Si oui, cela pourrait être votre rôle.
À propos du rôle
C'est une occasion rare de rejoindre l'équipe mondiale Transactions & Gouvernance juridique de Swiss Re dans un rôle juridique véritablement mondial. En tant que conseiller juridique, vous serez au cœur de la structuration, de la négociation et de l'exécution de certaines des opérations de réassurance et de capitaux alternatifs les plus complexes et les plus stratégiques du marché, depuis les valeurs mobilières liées à l'assurance et les solutions garanties jusqu'aux anciennes opérations de portefeuille et aux structures de gestion du capital.
Vous travaillerez d'un coup à l'autre avec les structuriers, les sous-traitants, les actuaires et les gestionnaires de clients, en apportant votre expertise juridique pour les transactions qui comptent — tout en assurant une gouvernance robuste, la conformité et les normes de gestion des risques sont maintenues.
Principales responsabilités :
• Fournir des conseils juridiques spécialisés sur les opérations complexes de réassurance et autres opérations en capital, y compris les titres liés à l'assurance, la réassurance structurée, la rétrocession, les solutions garanties et les opérations de portefeuille antérieures
• Examiner, rédiger et négocier les contrats et les documents juridiques pour toutes les phases du cycle de vie des transactions, de la structuration à l'exécution et à la mise en œuvre
• Exécuter une diligence raisonnable en matière juridique et réglementaire, analyser et conseiller les questions juridiques et réglementaires applicables aux activités de transaction de Swiss Re sur les marchés mondiaux
• Coordonner les équipes multidisciplinaires dans les domaines juridique, fiscal, comptable, financier, des risques et de la conformité afin d'appuyer l'exécution transparente des transactions
• Contribuer au développement des cadres de transaction, des modèles juridiques, des stratégies de négociation et des meilleures pratiques de Swiss Re dans toutes les unités commerciales
• Appuyer les processus de gouvernance des transactions, y compris l'élaboration de documents d'approbation, l'identification des risques juridiques et réglementaires et l'escalade des questions importantes à la haute direction
• Surveiller les tendances juridiques et réglementaires touchant les secteurs d'activité pertinents et conseiller activement les intervenants internes sur les faits nouveaux
• Instruisez et gérez des conseils extérieurs au besoin, en assurant la qualité et la rentabilité
• Faciliter la coordination internationale des questions juridiques et réglementaires, en aidant à maintenir et à adapter les cadres juridiques et réglementaires de Swiss Re
• Fournir des présentations internes et une formation sur des sujets juridiques en mettant l'accent sur les transactions, en partageant les connaissances dans l'ensemble de l'organisation
• Agir à titre de conseiller de confiance auprès des structurants, des assureurs et d'autres intervenants commerciaux tout au long du cycle de vie des transactions
• Fournir des rapports concis et opportuns sur les questions juridiques, y compris les progrès, les risques et les résultats, à la haute direction
À propos de l'équipe
Ce rôle fait partie de l'équipe juridique des opérations de P&C & L&H, qui fait partie de l'équipe générale des opérations et de la gouvernance juridique de Swiss Re. L'équipe fournit un soutien juridique spécialisé sur les transactions complexes de Propriété & Casualty, Vie & Santé et rétrocession dans l'ensemble de l'activité mondiale de Swiss Re.
Travaillant à l'intersection de l'expertise juridique et de la stratégie commerciale, l'équipe collabore étroitement avec les structurants, les assureurs, les partenaires financiers et un large éventail d'intervenants internes pour offrir des solutions novatrices de transfert des risques, tout en maintenant les normes les plus élevées de gouvernance et de gestion des risques. L'équipe joue un rôle central dans le soutien aux activités de gestion de capital de Swiss Re et aux initiatives alternatives de capital.
Il s'agit d'une équipe internationale véritablement collaborative qui fonctionne à l'échelle des administrations et des fonctions, réunissant des points de vue divers et des connaissances spécialisées approfondies. L'équipe s'est engagée à favoriser un environnement inclusif qui reflète les valeurs plus larges de Swiss Re : diversité d'âge, d'origine, de nationalité, d'identité de genre, d'expérience et de perspective à tous les niveaux.
À propos de toi
Vous êtes un avocat à l'esprit commercial, orienté vers les solutions qui combine de solides compétences techniques juridiques avec la capacité de construire des relations de confiance dans une organisation complexe et internationale. Vous apportez une curiosité intellectuelle, un jugement solide et un véritable enthousiasme pour travailler sur des transactions sophistiquées et à impact élevé. Vous êtes à l'aise pour naviguer l'ambiguïté, gérer des priorités concurrentes et contribuer à une équipe qui valorise la collaboration, l'intégrité et l'apprentissage continu.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :
• Avocat entièrement qualifié (examen de barre) au Royaume-Uni ou en Suisse (préféré), ou qualification équivalente dans une autre juridiction pertinente
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience post-qualification, idéalement acquise dans un cabinet d'avocats ou en interne dans l'industrie (re)assurance, avec une expertise démontrable en droit (re)assurance, opérations, règlements, et une compréhension fonctionnelle des structures structurées de financement et de garanties
• Expérience des questions de réglementation et d'octroi de licences dans les scénarios transfrontaliers, avec la capacité d'analyser et de conseiller sur des questions juridiques et réglementaires complexes et multigouvernementales
• Excellente capacité de rédaction, de négociation et de communication (écrite et verbale), avec la capacité de transmettre les concepts juridiques et de conformité de façon claire et concise à un éventail d'intervenants
• Connaissance de l'anglais (écrit et parlé); les compétences linguistiques supplémentaires sont un plus
Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:
• Expérience des titres liés à l'assurance, des structures de capital alternatives ou des opérations de portefeuille antérieures
• Connaissance des structures de réassurance garanties et des opérations de gestion du capital
• Exposition à la coordination internationale des questions juridiques et réglementaires dans plusieurs juridictions
• Expérience en matière de formation et de gestion des conseils externes
• Une expérience de contribution à l'élaboration de cadres juridiques, modèles ou meilleures pratiques dans une organisation complexe
• Fortes compétences interpersonnelles avec la capacité d'établir et de maintenir des relations de travail efficaces entre des équipes diverses, interfonctionnelles et internationales
• Une approche proactive et auto-réfléchissante — quelqu'un qui partage ouvertement sa pensée, qui est réceptif à un défi constructif et qui s'engage dans un perfectionnement professionnel continu
• Capacité démontrée de gérer de multiples questions et délais de façon indépendante, avec un appétit mesuré pour le risque et un accent sur la fourniture de solutions pratiques et pratiques
Renseignements sur les salaires
Pour Londres, l'échelle salariale de base pour ce poste se situe entre 94 000 et 140 000 GBP pour un poste à temps plein. Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:
• Exigences, portée, complexité et responsabilités du rôle
• Profil propre du candidat, y compris éducation/qualifications, expertise, spécialisation, compétences et expérience
En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement.
L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.
Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
#Li-Hybrid
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of facultative reinsurance across the Asia-Pacific region? If you have a passion for P&C reinsurance, a sharp eye for detail, and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment — this is the opportunity you've been waiting for!

About the Role

As a FAC Underwriting Coordinator I, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's Business Services - P&C Facultative underwriting operations, working closely with regional underwriters to deliver precise, timely, and high-quality support across the APAC markets. Your contributions will directly influence the productivity, efficiency, and profitability of the underwriting process — making your work both meaningful and impactful.

Key Responsibilities

• Understand and support the end-to-end P&C FAC underwriting process by providing both technical and operational assistance to APAC's P&C FAC Underwriters, ensuring seamless workflow and business continuity

• Handle submissions and pre-underwriting activities by performing thorough risk clearing and compliance-related checks (AML, ITC), setting up reinsurance risks in Swiss Re systems, and binding risks in tools as per final agreed terms

• Coordinate effectively with FAC P&C Desk Underwriters, FAC Hub Bangalore, and cross- functional team members to ensure timely and accurate delivery of business outputs

• Build and nurture strong stakeholder relationships, proactively seeking feedback to drive continuous improvement for both individual and team growth

• Oversee Business Services processes to ensure end-to-end process effectiveness, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing best practices

• Monitor portfolio performance including data quality, timeliness, and key targets, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established standards

• Evaluate and enhance business processes by identifying inefficiencies and contributing to process improvement initiatives that strengthen operational excellence

• Assist in Pre-Quote and Post Bind processes with simple renewal costing (e.g.: Roll forward & Empowered Pricing).

About the Team

The Business Services Facultative P&C APAC team is a dynamic, multinational, and highly engaged group that works directly with and supports client-facing underwriting teams across Asia- Pacific markets. Organized into smaller, focused sub-teams aligned to specific APAC markets, we operate as one unified team — sharing knowledge, expanding our reinsurance expertise, and delivering excellent service to our internal clients. We are driven by a shared commitment to professional development, collaboration, and a passion for making a real difference in the reinsurance landscape.

Our team values are at the core of everything we do: Client Centricity, Integrity, Passion to Perform, Team Spirit, and Agility. If these resonate with you, you'll feel right at home here

About You

You are a motivated, detail-oriented professional with a solid grounding in facultative reinsurance and a genuine enthusiasm for operational excellence. You bring a collaborative mindset, cultural sensitivity, and the adaptability to thrive in a globally connected environment. You take ownership of your work, communicate with clarity and confidence, and are always looking for ways to grow and contribute to the team's success.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 3-5 years of experience in the Insurance or Reinsurance industry, with a solid track record in operational or business services roles

Solid understanding of Facultative Property/Casualty insurance principles, including end-to- end underwriting process flow and a strong working knowledge of P&C reinsurance concepts

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to leverage these tools effectively for data management, reporting, and communication

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely across diverse, globally distributed teams

Strong customer-focus and service orientation, with a track record of building and maintaining productive stakeholder relationships

Ability to adapt quickly to changing tasks, priorities, and business environments

Flexibility and willingness to work during APAC time zone hours to support regional business needs

Experience with compliance-related checks such as AML and ITC in an insurance or reinsurance context

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Your role and responsibilities include:

• Manage divisional operations processes in alignment with Data & Technology strategic priorities

• Create, compile, and present management reports, presentations, and workforce data analyses

• Ensure adherence to the governance framework and support consistent operational standards

• Oversee Objectives & Key Results and manage quarterly review processes

• Prepare, coordinate, and facilitate leadership meetings and divisional events

• Act as a trusted partner and central point of contact for operational topics across the leadership team and wider division

We are the central D&T Finance Office, currently a team of four, embedded within a larger Tech Division of approximately 400 internal employees delivering technology capabilities for Swiss Re’s Finance function . As a globally present team, you will collaborate with colleagues across locations and time zones. We are responsible for strategic and financial oversight, communication strategy and execution, and key operational processes across the division.

About You

• Strategic and creative thinker with high energy, proactivity, and a strong can-do attitude

• Experience in operations management, project management, consulting, or similar fields, ideally with at least 5 years of relevant experience

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence engaging with leadership teams

• Proficient in MS Office / Office 365 tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and Loop

• Experienced in working with data, deriving insights, and using tools such as dashboards, Excel pivot tables, or similar reporting solutions

• Experienced in, or motivated to learn, how emerging AI and automation tools can improve operational efficiency and ways of working

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience. ​

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la vérification - Finances (Hybrid; h/f/x/j; 80-100%)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei un pensatore critico che prospera su audit complessi leader, sfidando lo status quo, e trasformando intuizioni di rischio in azioni significative? Vuoi lavorare in un team diverso e dinamico che abbraccia tecniche innovative e idee audaci? Unisciti al team di Swiss Re's Group Internal Audit (GIA) e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere la resilienza di Swiss Re, dall'interno verso l'esterno.

Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di amministratore di controllo finanziario all'interno del Gruppo Internal Audit, sarai al centro delle attività di audit di Swiss Re, che portano, contribuiscono e forniscono audit end-to-end in tutta la catena del valore Finance. Porterai la tua esperienza di business e finanza assicurativa a una vasta gamma di impegni di audit, valutando l'efficacia dei processi di governance, gestione dei rischi e controllo, allenando e coordinando i team di audit, impegnando regolarmente gli stakeholder senior e i leader funzionali in più unità aziendali.

Questo è un ruolo con impatto a livello aziendale. Aiuterai a plasmare e rafforzare la cultura del rischio di Swiss Re, acquisirai una profonda comprensione delle operazioni in tutte le divisioni e le funzioni, e fornirai raccomandazioni a valore aggiunto che veramente importano.

Principali responsabilità

• Condurre gli impegni di audit end-to-end in tutti i processi Finance, garantendo la governance, la gestione dei rischi, i controlli interni, la conformità normativa e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali e strategici

• Pianificare, supervisionare e rivedere i lavori di audit, garantire l'esecuzione tempestiva dei passaggi di processo, test di controllo, procedure sostanziali e impegni di consulenza in conformità con la metodologia Internal Audit e gli standard professionali

• Preparare e presentare relazioni di audit concise e di alta qualità, assicurando che le osservazioni siano basate su prove, equilibrate e concordate con le parti interessate — comunicando risultati complessi con chiarezza e fiducia

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni attendibili con la gestione, comunicare i progressi dell'audit, i risultati e le raccomandazioni, influenzando allo stesso tempo gli insight aziendali sostenibili e i miglioramenti dei processi e l'efficacia di controllo

• Valutare costantemente i rischi emergenti e gli sviluppi aziendali, contribuendo al processo di valutazione del rischio in corso e allo sviluppo del piano di audit interno semestrale

• Allenare e sviluppare i membri del team, promuovere la condivisione delle conoscenze e promuovere una cultura di miglioramento continuo, innovazione e prestazioni elevate all'interno della funzione di audit

Informazioni sulla squadra

GIA fornisce un'assicurazione indipendente e obiettiva per supportare il Consiglio di Amministrazione e il Comitato Esecutivo del Gruppo Swiss Re nella tutela dei beni, della reputazione e della sostenibilità a lungo termine dell'azienda.

La nostra visione è "avanzare la resilienza svizzera". Siamo un team internazionale di risolutori di problemi che portano da ogni sede, sfidare lo status quo, capire il rischio e sono reattivi al rischio. Applichiamo tecniche innovative e orientate al rischio per garantire che il nostro sforzo di audit sia proporzionale al rischio, e espandiamo continuamente l'uso di analisi e automazione dei dati all'interno dei nostri processi.

Il nostro team di Finance Audit è altamente collaborativo, mettendo insieme professionisti con competenze diverse, collaborando a stretto contatto con colleghi attraverso discipline attuariali, IT e di analisi dei dati. Con i membri del team di EMEA, Americas e Asia Pacific, avrete l'opportunità di collaborare a livello globale, imparare da una ricca varietà di prospettive, e costruire connessioni professionali significative che abbracciano i continenti.

A proposito di te

Sei un professionista curioso e orientato alla consegna che è appassionato di innovazione e trasformazione. Pensate in modo critico, comunicate con fiducia, e sono confortevoli navigare in ambienti ambigui. Un collaboratore naturale, siete sempre alla ricerca di modi migliori per fare le cose - e ispirate coloro che vi circondano a fare lo stesso. Unisci profonda competenza tecnica nel reporting finanziario, nella contabilità e nell'audit con forti competenze interpersonali e un autentico interesse per il rischio e la governance.

Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Conoscenza profonda degli standard contabili IFRS 17/9 e della rendicontazione finanziaria, sostenuta da una laurea in contabilità, scienze attuariali, business, o un campo finanziario correlato

• Provata esperienza nell'audit esterno e/o interno, o relativi ruoli finanziari all'interno del settore assicurativo, con dimostrata capacità di gestire gli impegni di audit come lead di audit ed eseguire procedure di pianificazione, test e reporting

• Forte comprensione del rischio, della governance e dei controlli interni, comprese le metodologie di audit interno e i quadri di valutazione del rischio continuo

• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e di coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, compresa l'esperienza con interviste e presentazioni; la fluidità in inglese (scritto e parlato) è essenziale

• Forti capacità di documentazione, tra cui passaggi di processo, narrazioni, diagrammi di flusso e test transazionali

• Gestione dell'esperienza degli stakeholder e dei team in un'organizzazione globale matrice

• Mindset commerciale con una forte attenzione ai dettagli e un approccio proattivo e auto-starter

• Forte conoscenza delle pratiche di gestione dei progetti e di gestione dei rischi

• Certificazioni professionali come CPA, CA, CIA o altre credenziali rilevanti

Compensazione

Per la Svizzera, la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra CHF 128.000 e CHF 192,000 per un ruolo a tempo pieno.

Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• I requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo

• Il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre, potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici della posizione. L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a critical thinker who thrives on leading complex audits, challenging the status quo, and turning risk insights into meaningful actions? Do you want to work in a diverse, dynamic team that embraces innovative techniques and bold ideas? Join Swiss Re's Group Internal Audit (GIA) team and play a pivotal role in advancing Swiss Re's resilience — from the inside out.

About the Role

As Finance Audit Manager within Group Internal Audit, you'll be at the heart of Swiss Re's audit activities — leading, contributing to, and delivering end-to-end audits across the Finance value chain. You'll bring your insurance business and finance expertise to a broad range of audit engagements, evaluating the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and control processes, coaching and coordinating the audit teams, while regularly engaging with senior stakeholders and functional leaders across multiple business units.

This is a role with enterprise-wide impact. You'll help shape and strengthen Swiss Re's risk culture, gain a deep understanding of operations across all divisions and functions, and deliver value-added recommendations that truly matter.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end audit engagements across Finance processes, providing assurance over governance, risk management, internal controls, regulatory compliance, and the achievement of business and strategic objectives

• Plan, supervise, and review audit work , ensuring timely execution of process walkthroughs, control testing, substantive procedures, and advisory engagements in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and professional standards

• Prepare and present concise, high-quality audit reports , ensuring observations are evidence-based, balanced, and agreed with stakeholders — communicating complex findings with clarity and confidence

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with management, communicating audit progress, findings, and recommendations while influencing sustainable business insights and improvements in processes and control effectiveness

• Continuously assess emerging risks and business developments , contributing to the ongoing risk assessment process and the development of the biannual Internal Audit Plan

• Coach and develop team members , promote knowledge sharing, and foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and high performance within the audit function

About the Team

GIA provides independent and objective assurance to support Swiss Re's Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting the company's assets, reputation, and long-term sustainability.

Our vision is 'Advancing Swiss Re's Resilience'. We are an international team of problem solvers who lead from every seat, challenge the status quo, understand risk and are responsive to risk. We apply innovative and risk-focused techniques to ensure that our audit effort is proportionate to risk, and we continuously expand the use of data analytics and automation within our processes.

Our Finance Audit team is highly collaborative, bringing together professionals with diverse expertise — partnering closely with colleagues across actuarial, IT, and data analytics disciplines. With team members based across EMEA, Americas, and Asia Pacific, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate globally, learn from a rich variety of perspectives, and build meaningful professional connections that span continents.

About You

You are a curious, delivery-oriented professional who is passionate about innovation and transformation. You think critically, communicate with confidence, and are comfortable navigating ambiguous environments. A natural collaborator, you're always looking for better ways to do things — and you inspire those around you to do the same. You combine deep technical expertise in financial reporting, accounting, and audit with strong interpersonal skills and a genuine interest in risk and governance.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Deep knowledge of IFRS 17/9 accounting standards and financial reporting, supported by a degree in accounting, actuarial science, business, or a related finance field

• Proven experience in external and/or internal audit , or related finance roles within the insurance industry, with demonstrated ability to manage audit engagements as audit lead and perform planning, testing and reporting procedures

• Strong understanding of risk, governance, and internal controls , including internal audit methodologies and continuous risk assessment frameworks

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills , including experience with interviewing and presentations; fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential

• Strong documentation skills , including process walkthroughs, narratives, flowcharts, and transactional testing

• Experience managing stakeholders and teams in a global, matrixed organization

• Commercial mindset with strong attention to detail and a proactive, self-starter approach

• Strong knowledge of project management and risk management practices

• Professional certification such as CPA, CA, CIA , or another relevant credential

Compensation

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 128,000 and CHF 192,000 for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Furthermore, you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie ein kritischer Denker, der es schafft, komplexe Audits zu leiten, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen und Risikoerkenntnisse in sinnvolle Maßnahmen umzuwandeln? Möchten Sie in einem vielfältigen, dynamischen Team arbeiten, das innovative Techniken und mutige Ideen umarmt? Treten Sie dem Team Group Internal Audit (GIA) von Swiss Re bei und spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung der Widerstandsfähigkeit von Swiss Re – von innen heraus.

Über die Rolle

Als Finance Audit Manager bei Group Internal Audit stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt der Prüfungsaktivitäten von Swiss Re – Sie führen, tragen zu und liefern End-to-End-Prüfungen entlang der gesamten Finanzwertschöpfungskette. Sie bringen Ihr Versicherungsgeschäft und Ihre Finanzexpertise in ein breites Spektrum von Audit-Verpflichtungen ein, bewerten die Wirksamkeit von Governance-, Risikomanagement- und Kontrollprozessen, coachen und koordinieren die Audit-Teams, während Sie regelmäßig mit leitenden Stakeholdern und funktionalen Führungskräften in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen zusammenarbeiten.

Dies ist eine Rolle mit unternehmensweiter Wirkung. Sie tragen dazu bei, die Risikokultur von Swiss Re mitzugestalten und zu stärken, ein tiefes Verständnis der Abläufe in allen Divisionen und Funktionen zu erlangen und wertschöpfende Empfehlungen zu liefern, die wirklich wichtig sind.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie End-to-End-Prüfungsaufträge über alle Finanzprozesse hinweg und bieten Sie Sicherheit in Bezug auf Governance, Risikomanagement, interne Kontrollen, Einhaltung der Vorschriften und die Erreichung geschäftlicher und strategischer Ziele

• Planen, beaufsichtigen und überprüfen Sie die Auditarbeit und gewährleisten Sie die rechtzeitige Durchführung von Prozessdurchläufen, Kontrolltests, substanziellen Verfahren und Beratungsaufträgen in Übereinstimmung mit der internen Auditmethodik und professionellen Standards

• Prägnante, qualitativ hochwertige Auditberichte erstellen und präsentieren, um sicherzustellen, dass die Beobachtungen evidenzbasiert, ausgewogen und mit den Stakeholdern abgestimmt sind - komplexe Ergebnisse mit Klarheit und Vertrauen kommunizieren

• Aufbau und Pflege vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zum Management, Kommunikation von Auditfortschritten, Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen, während nachhaltige Geschäftserkenntnisse und Verbesserungen der Prozesse und der Kontrolleffektivität beeinflusst werden

• Kontinuierliche Bewertung neu auftretender Risiken und Geschäftsentwicklungen, Beitrag zum laufenden Risikobewertungsprozess und zur Entwicklung des halbjährlichen internen Auditplans

• Coaching und Entwicklung von Teammitgliedern, Förderung des Wissensaustauschs und Förderung einer Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, Innovation und hohen Leistung innerhalb der Auditfunktion

Über das Team

Die GIA bietet eine unabhängige und objektive Zusicherung, um den Verwaltungsrat und die Konzernleitung von Swiss Re beim Schutz der Vermögenswerte, des Rufs und der langfristigen Nachhaltigkeit des Unternehmens zu unterstützen.

Unsere Vision ist "Advancing Swiss Re's Resilience". Wir sind ein internationales Team von Problemlösern, die von jedem Sitz aus führen, den Status quo herausfordern, Risiken verstehen und auf Risiken reagieren. Wir wenden innovative und risikoorientierte Techniken an, um sicherzustellen, dass unser Prüfungsaufwand in einem angemessenen Verhältnis zum Risiko steht, und wir erweitern kontinuierlich den Einsatz von Datenanalyse und Automatisierung in unseren Prozessen.

Unser Finance Audit-Team ist sehr kooperativ und bringt Fachleute mit unterschiedlichem Fachwissen zusammen - eng mit Kollegen aus den Disziplinen Versicherungsmathematik, IT und Datenanalyse. Mit Teammitgliedern in EMEA, Amerika und im asiatisch-pazifischen Raum haben Sie die Möglichkeit, weltweit zusammenzuarbeiten, aus einer Vielzahl von Perspektiven zu lernen und sinnvolle professionelle Verbindungen aufzubauen, die sich über Kontinente erstrecken.

Über dich

Sie sind ein neugieriger, lieferungsorientierter Fachmann, der sich für Innovation und Transformation begeistert. Sie denken kritisch, kommunizieren mit Selbstvertrauen und navigieren in mehrdeutigen Umgebungen. Als natürlicher Mitarbeiter sind Sie immer auf der Suche nach besseren Möglichkeiten, Dinge zu tun - und Sie inspirieren diejenigen um Sie herum, dasselbe zu tun. Sie kombinieren fundiertes technisches Fachwissen in den Bereichen Finanzberichterstattung, Buchhaltung und Audit mit starken zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten und einem echten Interesse an Risiko und Governance.

Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Tiefe Kenntnisse der IFRS 17/9 Rechnungslegungsstandards und Finanzberichterstattung, unterstützt durch einen Abschluss in Rechnungswesen, Versicherungsmathematik, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Finanzbereich

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in externen und / oder internen Audits oder verwandten Finanzrollen in der Versicherungsbranche mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, Audit-Verpflichtungen als Auditleiter zu verwalten und Planungs-, Test- und Berichtsverfahren durchzuführen

• Starkes Verständnis von Risiko, Governance und internen Kontrollen, einschließlich interner Auditmethoden und kontinuierlicher Risikobewertungsrahmen

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Engagement-Fähigkeiten, einschließlich Erfahrung mit Interviews und Präsentationen; fließend Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) ist unerlässlich

• Starke Dokumentationsfähigkeiten, einschließlich Prozessdurchläufe, Erzählungen, Flussdiagramme und Transaktionstests

• Erfahrung im Management von Stakeholdern und Teams in einer globalen, matrixförmigen Organisation

• Kommerzielle Denkweise mit starker Liebe zum Detail und einem proaktiven, selbststartenden Ansatz

• Starkes Wissen über Projektmanagement und Risikomanagementpraktiken

• Professionelle Zertifizierungen wie CPA, CA, CIA oder andere relevante Nachweise

Ausgleich

Für die Schweiz liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Stelle zwischen CHF 128.000 und CHF 192.000 für eine Vollzeitstelle.

Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Verantwortlichkeiten der Rolle

• Eigenes Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt. Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen. Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.

Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous un penseur critique qui prospère en menant des vérifications complexes, en contestant le statu quo et en transformant les connaissances sur les risques en mesures significatives? Voulez-vous travailler dans une équipe diversifiée et dynamique qui embrasse des techniques innovantes et des idées audacieuses? Rejoignez l'équipe du Groupe d'audit interne (GIA) de Swiss Re et jouez un rôle central dans l'amélioration de la résilience de Swiss Re.

À propos du rôle

En tant que responsable de l'audit financier au sein de l'audit interne du Groupe, vous serez au cœur des activités d'audit de Swiss Re. Vous apporterez votre expertise en matière d'assurances et de finances à un large éventail de missions de vérification, en évaluant l'efficacité des processus de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et de contrôle, en coachant et en coordonnant les équipes de vérification, tout en collaborant régulièrement avec des intervenants supérieurs et des dirigeants fonctionnels dans plusieurs unités opérationnelles.

Il s'agit d'un rôle à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Vous aiderez à façonner et à renforcer la culture du risque de Swiss Re, à acquérir une compréhension approfondie des opérations dans toutes les divisions et fonctions et à fournir des recommandations à valeur ajoutée qui comptent vraiment.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger les missions de vérification de bout en bout dans l'ensemble des processus financiers, en assurant la gouvernance, la gestion du risque, les contrôles internes, la conformité à la réglementation et la réalisation des objectifs opérationnels et stratégiques

• Planifier, superviser et examiner les travaux d'audit, en veillant à ce que les processus soient exécutés en temps opportun, les essais de contrôle, les procédures de fond et les engagements consultatifs conformément à la méthodologie d'audit interne et aux normes professionnelles

• Préparer et présenter des rapports d'audit concis et de haute qualité , en veillant à ce que les observations soient fondées sur des données probantes, équilibrées et approuvées par les parties prenantes — communiquer des constatations complexes avec clarté et confiance

• Établir et maintenir des relations de confiance avec la direction, communiquer les progrès, les constatations et les recommandations de la vérification, tout en influençant les perspectives opérationnelles durables et les améliorations des processus et de l'efficacité du contrôle

• Évaluer continuellement les risques émergents et les développements opérationnels , contribuant au processus d'évaluation des risques en cours et à l'élaboration du plan de vérification interne semestriel

• Coacher et développer les membres de l'équipe, promouvoir le partage des connaissances et favoriser une culture d'amélioration continue, d'innovation et de haute performance au sein de la fonction d'audit

À propos de l'équipe

GIA fournit une assurance indépendante et objective pour soutenir le conseil d'administration et le comité exécutif du groupe Swiss Re dans la protection des actifs, de la réputation et de la durabilité à long terme de l'entreprise.

Notre vision est de faire progresser la résilience de Swiss Re. Nous sommes une équipe internationale de résolveurs de problèmes qui mènent de chaque siège, défient le statu quo, comprennent le risque et sont réceptifs au risque. Nous appliquons des techniques novatrices et axées sur les risques pour nous assurer que nos efforts d'audit sont proportionnels aux risques, et nous étendons continuellement l'utilisation de l'analyse et de l'automatisation des données dans nos processus.

Notre équipe d'audit des finances est très collaborative, réunissant des professionnels ayant une expertise diversifiée – en partenariat étroit avec des collègues dans les disciplines actuarielle, informatique et data analytics. Avec des membres d'équipe basés à travers l'EMEA, les Amériques et l'Asie-Pacifique, vous aurez l'occasion de collaborer à l'échelle mondiale, d'apprendre d'une riche variété de perspectives et de créer des liens professionnels significatifs qui s'étendent sur les continents.

À propos de toi

Vous êtes un professionnel curieux, orienté vers la livraison, passionné par l'innovation et la transformation. Vous pensez critiquement, communiquez avec confiance et naviguez confortablement dans des environnements ambigus. Collaborateur naturel, vous cherchez toujours de meilleures façons de faire les choses — et vous inspirez ceux qui vous entourent à faire de même. Vous combinez une expertise technique approfondie dans les rapports financiers, la comptabilité et l'audit avec de solides compétences interpersonnelles et un véritable intérêt pour le risque et la gouvernance.

Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Connaissance approfondie des normes comptables et de l'information financière IFRS 17/9, appuyée par un diplôme en comptabilité, en science actuarielle, en affaires ou dans un domaine financier connexe

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de vérification externe et/ou interne , ou de rôles financiers connexes au sein du secteur de l'assurance, avec une capacité démontrée de gérer les missions de vérification à titre de responsable de la vérification et d'exécuter des procédures de planification, d'essai et de rapport

• Bonne compréhension des risques, de la gouvernance et des contrôles internes , y compris les méthodes d'audit interne et les cadres d'évaluation continue des risques

• Excellente capacité de communication et d'engagement des intervenants , y compris l'expérience des entrevues et des présentations; la maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et parlé) est essentielle

• Fortes compétences en documentation , y compris la démarche, les récits, les diagrammes de flux et les tests transactionnels

• Expérience de la gestion des parties prenantes et des équipes dans une organisation mondiale matricielle

• Un état d'esprit commercial avec une grande attention aux détails et une approche proactive et auto-démarrante

• Bonne connaissance des pratiques de gestion de projet et de gestion des risques

• Certification professionnelle telle que CPA, CA, CIA, ou un autre titre pertinent

Rémunération

Pour la Suisse, l'échelle de salaire de base pour ce poste se situe entre CHF 128 000 et CHF 192 000 pour un rôle à temps plein.

Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• Exigences, portée, complexité et responsabilités du rôle

• Profil propre du candidat, y compris éducation/qualifications, expertise, spécialisation, compétences et expérience

En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement. L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.

À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Informazioni sul ruolo
L'Analista di contabilità tecnica I è un ruolo entry-level progettato per i colleghi che sono presto nella loro carriera contabile e pronto a costruire competenze nella contabilità di riassicurazione. Ti concentrerai sulla padronanza dei processi contabili chiave, garantendo alta qualità dei dati, supportando la gestione del portafoglio e sviluppando l'indipendenza nei compiti quotidiani in quanto la tua esperienza cresce.
Principali responsabilità
Responsabilità tecniche fondamentali:

• Eseguire la gestione basata su eccezioni dei conti con una forte attenzione alla qualità dei dati e alla creazione di valore.

• Eseguire la verifica tecnica dei conti all’interno del quadro di convalida dell’azienda e la formulazione dei contratti.

• Condurre il trattamento dei conti in base alle linee guida e ai processi stabiliti, compresa la gestione delle escalation secondo le necessità.

• Gestisci l'equilibrio con i clienti esterni in base ai termini e agli accordi di riassicurazione.

• Mantenere la gestione del flusso di cassa, inclusa la raccolta tempestiva di Accounts Recepibili e il monitoraggio delle finanze del portafoglio.

• Assicurarsi che tutte le transazioni finanziarie / pagamenti aderiscano ai processi, al quadro di gestione della qualità e ai controlli interni chiave.

• Eseguire controlli regolari e analisi della politica dei clienti e dei file finanziari, identificare discrepanze e risolvere proattivamente i problemi.

• Mantenere la comunicazione interna/esterno del cliente per i conti assegnati.

• Guide peers su questioni contabili di riassicurazione quando necessario.

• Lavoro di portafoglio di supporto, fornire autorizzazioni/escalation di transazioni finanziarie e pagamenti secondo matrice di autorità.
A proposito di te

• Laurea post-secondaria o esperienza equivalente in Contabilità, Finanza, Business Administration, Economia o una disciplina relativa.

• Forte capacità analitiche, attenzione ai dettagli e comfort lavorando con i numeri.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta in inglese.

• Proattivo e agile giocatore di squadra con la volontà di imparare e crescere.

• Capacità di gestire il carico di lavoro assegnato e fornire risultati di alta qualità in tempo.

• Competenza Solid MS Excel; Power BI è un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di lavorare in collaborazione tra team.

• Mindset proattivo, adattabile e curioso con la capacità di imparare rapidamente nuovi strumenti e processi.
Bello da avere

• Esperienza in (re) assicurazione, operazioni finanziarie, contabilità o contabilità tecnica.

• Comprensione delle strutture dei trattati, dei flussi di lavoro di cedent/broker e dei processi di riassicurazione dei dati.

• La seconda lingua è un vantaggio da avere.
Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 1 300 EUR e 2 200 EUR al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione.
L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.

Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. About the Role
The Technical Accounting Analyst I is an entry-level role designed for colleagues who are early in their accounting career and ready to build expertise in reinsurance accounting. You will focus on mastering key accounting processes, ensuring high data quality, supporting portfolio handling, and developing independence in daily tasks as your experience grows.
Key Responsibilities
Core Technical Responsibilities:

• Perform exception-based handling of accounts with strong focus on data quality and value creation.

• Execute technical verification of accounts within the company’s validation framework and contract wording.

• Conduct account processing according to established guidelines and processes, including handling escalations as needed.

• Manage balance settlement with external clients according to reinsurance terms and agreements.

• Handle cash flow management including timely collection of Accounts Receivable and monitoring of portfolio financials.

• Ensure all financial transactions/payments adhere to processes, the quality management framework and key internal controls.

• Perform regular checks and analysis of client policy and financial files, identifying discrepancies and proactively resolving issues.

• Handle internal/external client communication for assigned accounts.

• Guide peers on reinsurance accounting matters when required.

• Support portfolio work, provide authorizations/escalations of financial transactions and payments according to authority matrix.
About You

• Post-secondary degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and comfort working with numbers.

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Proactive and agile team player with a willingness to learn and grow.

• Ability to manage assigned workload and deliver high-quality results on time.

• Solid MS Excel proficiency; Power BI is an advantage.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

• Proactive, adaptable, and curious mindset with the ability to learn new tools and processes quickly.
Nice to Have

• Experience in (re)insurance, finance operations, accounting, or technical accounting.

• Understanding of treaty structures, cedent/broker workflows, and reinsurance data processes.

• Second language is an advantage to have.
For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between 1 300 EUR and 2 200 EUR per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
#LI-Hybrid
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

You will be joining a team that has extensive knowledge in the national D&O marketplace, and one that works closely with clients to provide tailored insurance solutions. Collaboration amongst team members is our differentiator so that we focus and deliver on stellar insured-centric service. As an Associate Underwriter, you will work alongside seasoned colleagues who will provide mentorship, training, and opportunities to develop your underwriting and insurance knowledge.
About The Role
We are looking for a pro-active, highly motivated and result-oriented Associate Underwriter (or Underwriter) to join the Professional & Financial Services (FINPRO) team within Corporate Solutions.
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career insurance professional or recent graduate interested in developing expertise in Directors & Officers Liability (D&O), Employment Practices Liability (EPL), and Fiduciary Liability insurance . You will support underwriting activities while learning how to evaluate risks, structure insurance solutions, and build strong relationships with brokers and clients.
Working closely with senior underwriters, you will assist in analyzing risks, preparing quotations, reviewing submissions, and supporting the growth of our private and nonprofit D&O portfolio. You will also gain exposure to client and broker interactions, participate in team projects, and collaborate with colleagues across the organization.
Key Responsibilities

• Support the underwriting team in evaluating new and renewal business opportunities.

• Review insurance submissions and gather relevant financial and operational information.

• Assist in analyzing risk exposures and coverage requirements.

• Prepare underwriting documentation, quotations, and policy-related materials.

• Conduct market and industry research to support underwriting decisions.

• Develop knowledge of D&O, Employment Practices Liability, and Fiduciary Liability insurance products.

• Build and maintain relationships with brokers and internal stakeholders.

• Participate in training programs, team projects, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Maintain accurate underwriting records and systems documentation.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

• Self-motivated with a willingness to take initiative and learn from experienced colleagues.

• Collaborative team player with a positive and professional attitude.

• Interest in developing a long-term career in underwriting and financial lines insurance.

• Willingness to travel occasionally as needed.

About The Team
You will be joining a team that has extensive knowledge in the national D&O marketplace, and one that works closely with clients to provide tailored insurance solutions. The team colleagues are made up of professionals with financial and underwriting expertise and a wealth of experience in the Executive Risks insurance sector. Collaboration amongst team members is our differentiator so that we focus and deliver on stellar insured-centric service. As an Associate Underwriter, you will work alongside seasoned colleagues who will provide mentorship, training, and opportunities to develop your underwriting and insurance knowledge.
About The Role
We are looking for a pro-active, highly motivated and result-oriented Associate Underwriter (or Underwriter) to join the Professional & Financial Services (FINPRO) team within Corporate Solutions.
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career insurance professional or recent graduate interested in developing expertise in  Directors & Officers Liability (D&O), Employment Practices Liability (EPL), and Fiduciary Liability insurance . You will support underwriting activities while learning how to evaluate risks, structure insurance solutions, and build strong relationships with brokers and clients.
Working closely with senior underwriters, you will assist in analyzing risks, preparing quotations, reviewing submissions, and supporting the growth of our private and nonprofit D&O portfolio. You will also gain exposure to client and broker interactions, participate in team projects, and collaborate with colleagues across the organization.
Key Responsibilities

• Support the underwriting team in evaluating new and renewal business opportunities.

• Review insurance submissions and gather relevant financial and operational information.

• Assist in analyzing risk exposures and coverage requirements.

• Prepare underwriting documentation, quotations, and policy-related materials.

• Conduct market and industry research to support underwriting decisions.

• Develop knowledge of D&O, Employment Practices Liability, and Fiduciary Liability insurance products.

• Build and maintain relationships with brokers and internal stakeholders.

• Participate in training programs, team projects, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Maintain accurate underwriting records and systems documentation.
This position is located in Chicago, Illinois. Relocation is not an option. SwissRe uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred.
About You

• Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Insurance, or a related field preferred.

• 0 to 5 years of experience in insurance, underwriting, finance, banking, accounting, or a related professional environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to learn quickly and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

• Self-motivated with a willingness to take initiative and learn from experienced colleagues.

• Collaborative team player with a positive and professional attitude.

• Interest in developing a long-term career in underwriting and financial lines insurance.

• Willingness to travel occasionally as needed.
The estimated base salary range for this role is $72,000 to $108,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget.  At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

In force Management Actuary – D band
Are you a commercially minded actuary who thrives at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and client impact? Do you want to go beyond the numbers and actively shape the financial performance of a global reinsurance portfolio? If so, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference.
About the Role
This is a compelling opportunity for a qualified Fellow (or experienced Associate) of the Society of Actuaries to join Swiss Re's In-Force Management (IFM) team and play a central role in actively managing and optimizing the Americas Life & Health in force block, with a primary focus on the US portfolio .
In Force Management's mission is clear: defend and enhance the value of Swiss Re's Life & Health in force business . In support of this mission, you will develop actionable portfolio insights, design and execute value-accretive in force actions, and manage ongoing in force maintenance requests with discipline and responsiveness. In force actions create value through CSM generation , derisking underperforming business, and delivering capital and capacity relief.
This role offers rich technical development, deeper understanding of reinsurance treaty terms, meaningful client interactions, and the opportunity to sharpen your project management, negotiation, and communication skills.
Key Responsibilities
In Force Portfolio Understanding

• Proactively identify and assess potential in force opportunities using a variety of tools, including the Portfolio Health Database and the Stargate big-data platform

• Advance the use of dashboard analytics , actuarial modeling, and AI tools to enhance portfolio understanding, and recommend and prioritize actions

• Partner with the US Market Unit on WISER responsibilities by monitoring treaty-level loss ratios and emerging performance trends

• Develop in force portfolio communication materials for clients and internal stakeholders to deepen understanding of the portfolio and any recommended actions
In Force Costing Capabilities

• Build and apply in force costing capabilities through live transaction experience

• Conduct calibrations using seriatim experience studies to calibrate deal-level actuarial assumptions for rate reviews and recaptures

• Leverage Valuation AXIS models , perform model reviews, and conduct model validation exercises

• Structure commercially sound and innovative in force actions

• Support internal and external negotiations , presentations, and decision-making forums
Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with subject matter experts across a range of in force topics, including Client Markets, Products, Contracts, Valuation, Finance, Legal, Reinsurance Admin, Risk Management, and the broader In Force Optimization team

• Clearly communicate in force strategy, prioritization, and trade-offs to diverse audiences

• Advance the deal pipeline with cross-functional teams from origination through treaty execution
Client Requests and Engagements

• Prioritize and address internal and client in force requests for non-contractual treaty changes and exceptions

• Evaluate and respond to client-initiated contractual recaptures

• Understand ceding client perspectives and help identify reasonable alternative solutions when necessary
About the Team
The L&H In Force Management team sits within Swiss Re's broader L&H In Force Optimization global team — a collaborative, high-impact group that partners closely with Market Units worldwide to identify opportunities and execute actions that strengthen the performance, resilience, and growth of the global L&H in force portfolio.
The In Force Management team holds specific accountability for the US and Canada portfolios , driving performance improvement through treaty-level actions and negotiations. The team works hand-in-hand with the US and Canada Market Units to enhance portfolio quality while preserving and strengthening valued client relationships. You'll be joining a team that combines deep technical expertise with a strong commercial mindset and a genuine commitment to collaboration.
About You
You are a commercially minded actuarial professional with Life & Health (re)insurance expertise, strong analytical capacity, and the communication skills to translate complex portfolio insights into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. You have a genuine desire to turn data into action — driving financial outcomes that matter for Swiss Re and its clients.
You bring a strategic mindset balanced with attention to detail, and you thrive in cross-functional environments where collaboration, clear communication, and accountability are essential. You are comfortable managing multiple priorities, navigating ambiguity, and delivering results on time-sensitive projects. You approach challenges with intellectual curiosity, a structured problem-solving mindset, and a commitment to transparency with senior stakeholders.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in life insurance or reinsurance, with direct exposure to in force management, pricing, or portfolio optimization

• FSA designation , experienced qualified ASA, or equivalent actuarial designation

• Actuarial modeling proficiency , including experience with financial analysis, performance monitoring frameworks, and familiarity with GGY AXIS modeling software

• Strong understanding of IFRS-17 accounting framework as applied to L&H business

• University degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, or a related field
These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working with big-data platforms (e.g., Stargate or similar) and advanced analytics or AI tools

• Familiarity with reinsurance treaty structures and in force transaction mechanics, including recaptures and rate reviews

• Experience conducting seriatim experience studies and calibrating deal-level actuarial assumptions

• Demonstrated ability to develop and present recommendations to senior leadership and external clients with clarity and confidence

• Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration in complex, matrixed organizational environments

• Experience with client-facing negotiations or commercial structuring of in force actions
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office three days per week, every week. In addition, this role does not offer relocation or any type of visa/visa transfer support.
The estimated base salary range for this position in Fort Wayne, IN; Chicago, IL or Kansas City, MO is $146,000 to $244,000, and the range for Armonk, NY is $156,000 to $256,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short- and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
